sa: यद्यात्मनि परस्मिश्च समतामध्यवस्यसि। अथ मां कासि कस्येति किमर्थमनुपृच्छसि॥
en: If it is true that you see an identity with yourself and others, why then did you ask me who I am and whose?

sa: कर्मणा बीजभूतेन चोद्यते यद् यदिन्द्रियम्। जायते तदहङ्काराद् रागयुक्तेन चेतसा॥
en: Whatever senses, while it is there, are awakened by pristine deeds as the operating cause, become created in Consciousness in consequence of the mind co-existing with attachments.

sa: क्रोधात् काममवाप्याथ लोभमोहौ च मानवाः। मानदर्पावहङ्कारमहङ्कारात् ततः क्रियाः॥
en: From anger, they become subject to desire. From desire originate cupidity, delusion, vanity, pride and selfishness. From such selfishness proceed various sorts of acts.

sa: व्यत्यासेनोपयुक्तस्ते चरुर्व्यक्तं भविष्यति। व्यत्यास: पादपे चापि सुव्यक्तं कृतः शुभे॥
en: O excellent lady, you have not done well in exchanging the charu as will soon be seen. It is also clear that you have changed the trees.

sa: विश्वामित्रं चाजनयद् गाधिभार्या यशस्विनी। ऋषेः प्रसादाद् राजेन्द्र ब्रह्मर्षेब्रह्मवादिनम्॥
en: The famous wife of Gadhi too gave birth to the twiceborn Rishi Vishvamitra versed in the knowledge of Brahma, by favour of that Rishi.

sa: लोहयुक्तं यथा हेम विपक्वं न विराजते। तथापक्वकषायाख्यं विज्ञानं न प्रकाशते॥
en: As gold, when united with iron, losses its purity and cannot shine, so Knowledge, when existing with attachment to earthly objects and such other shortcomings, fails to display its splendour.

sa: वर्णोत्कर्षमवाप्नोति नरः पुण्येन कर्मणा। दुर्लभं तमलब्ध्वा हि हन्यात् पापेन कर्मणा॥
en: Man attains to a superior colour by pious deeds. Unable to acquire a superior colour for such acquisition is highly difficult, a person, by doing sinful deeds only kills himself.

sa: विरक्तं शोध्यते वस्त्रं न तु कृष्णोपसंहितम्। प्रयत्नेन मनुष्येन्द्र पापमेवं निबोध मे॥
en: An uncoloured cloth, when dirty, can be purified, but not a piece of cloth which is dyed with black; so, O king, listen to me with care, is it the case with sin.

sa: न तथा मानुषे लोके भयमस्ति शुभाशुभे। तथा त्रिदशलोके हि भयमन्येन जायते॥
en: The apprehension of good or evil in this world is not Destiny be unfavourable as his apprehension of the same in the other world if Exertion be wanting while here. SO great if

sa: यो निर्वदेत सम्मोहाद् ब्राह्मणं वेदपारगम्॥ सोऽभिध्यानाद् ब्राह्मणस्य पराभूयाद संशयम्।
en: That man who, through stupefaction of intellect, speaks ill of a Brahmana well-read in the Vedas, is certain to meet with humiliation on account of such evil-speaking.

sa: वेदस्याध्ययनं हीदं तच्च कार्यं महत् स्मृतम्॥ स्तुत्यर्थमिह देवानां वेदाः सृष्टाः स्वयम्भुवा।
en: These are the rules about the study of the Vedas. This again is considered as a high task. The Vedas were created by the Self-create for the purpose of praising the gods therewith.

sa: न च फलति विकर्मा जीवलोक न दैवं व्यपनयति विमार्गं नास्ति दैवे प्रभुत्वम्। गुरुमिव कृतमय्यं कर्म संयाति दैवं नयति पुरुषकारः संचितस्तत्र तत्र॥
en: The inan who does not cxert himself is never contented in this world, nor can Destiny change the course of a man who has gone wrong. There is no power inherent in Destiny. As the pupil follows the preceptor, so does one's action, guided by Destiny, follows his own personal exertion. Where one's own exertion is displayed, there only Destiny, shows its hand.

sa: धर्म एव सदा नृणामिह राजन् प्रशस्यते। धर्मवृद्धा गुणानेव सेवन्ते हि नरा भुवि॥
en: At the time of which we speak, O king, Virtue, and nothing else, was much praised among men. Having achieved great progress in virtue, men in those days adored only all good qualities that they saw.

sa: लोभप्रभवमज्ञानं वृद्धं भूयः प्रवर्धते। स्थाने स्थानं क्षये क्षैण्यमुपैति विविधां गतिम्॥
en: Ignorance originates from covetousness. Ignorance grows along with coveteousness. Ignorance exists simultaneously with covetousness. Ignorance decreases with covetousness. It rises with the rise of covetousness. Manifold again is its course.

sa: अभ्युत्थानेन दैवस्य समारब्धेन कर्मणा। विधिना कर्मणा चैव स्वर्गमार्गमवाप्नुयात्॥
en: By the influence of Destiny, and by showing personal Exertion, do men attain to heaven. The combined help of Destiny and Exertion, becomes fruitful.

sa: ताः प्राप्य तु स धिग्दण्डो न कारणमतोऽभवत्। ततोऽभ्यगच्छन् देवांश्च ब्राह्मणांश्चावमन्य ह॥
en: When men became such, the punishment of mere depreciation on transgressors could produce no effect. Men, showing no respect of either the gods or Brahmanas, began to indulge their senses to their fill.

sa: न चैषां मैथुनो धर्मो बभूव भरतर्षभ। संकल्पादेव चैतेषामपत्यमुपपद्यते॥
en: Sexual intercourse, O chief of the Bharatas, was then not necessary for perpetuating the race. In those days, offspring were begotten by the will.

sa: दमं निःश्रेयसं प्राहुर्वृद्धा निश्चितदर्शिनः। ब्राह्मणस्य विशेषेण दमो धर्मः सनातनः॥
en: Those amongst the ancient Rishis that were acquainted with truth said that self-control, leads to the highest merit. Self-control is the eternal duty of the Brahmanas especially.

sa: एवमध्यापयशिष्यान् व्यासः पुत्रं च वीर्यवान्। उवास हिमवत्पृष्ठे पाराशर्यो महामुनिः॥
en: After the arrival of his powerful son, Vyasa, the son of Parashara, continued to live there on the Himavat, engaged in teaching his disciples, and his son.

sa: यं निरीक्षेत संक्रुद्ध आशया पूर्वजातया। प्रदहेच्च हि तं राजन् कक्षमक्षय्यभुग यथा॥
en: That man upon whom a Brahmana with raised expectations looks, is sure, O king, to be reduced to ashes as a heap of straw is capable of being consumed by a burning fire.

sa: मरीचिः कश्यपं तात पुत्रमग्रजमग्रजः। मानसं जनयामास तैजसं ब्रह्मवित्तमम्॥
en: The eldest born, viz., Marichi, beget, by his will, a son named Kashyapa, highly energetic and the foremost of all person conversant with Brahma.

sa: पुत्रान् पौत्रान् पशुंश्चैव बान्धवान् सचिवांस्तथा। पुरं जनपदं चैव शान्तिरिष्टेन पोषयेत्॥
en: Such a Brahimana is sure to maintain peacefully the sons and grandsons and animals and relatives and ministers and other officers and the city and the provinces of the king.

sa: महद्धि भरतश्रेष्ठ ब्राह्मणस्तीर्थमुच्यते। वेलायां न तु कस्यांचिद् गच्छेद् विप्रो ह्यपूजितः।।२८
en: O chief of the Bharatas, the Brahmana is considered as the highest object to whom gifts should be made. At no time should a Brahmana be received without due adoration.

sa: तत्र कश्चित् समुत्साहं कृत्वा शूद्रो दयान्वितः। आगतो ह्याश्रमपदं पूजितश्च तपस्विभिः॥
en: Once upon a time a Shudra endued with mercy for all creatures, ventured to come into that herinitage. Arrived at that retreat, he was duiy honoured by all the ascetics.

sa: शकुनीनामिवाकाशे जले वारिचरस्य च। यथा गतिर्न दृश्येत तथा तस्य न संशयः॥
en: As the route of birds along the sky or of fowl over the surface of water cannot be made out, so the path of such a person (on Earth) does not attract notice.

sa: अथास्य मुनिरागच्छत् संगत्या वै तमाश्रमम्। सम्पूज्य स्वागतेनर्षि विधिवत् समतोषयत्॥
en: One day an ascetic came to that Shudra's asylum for making his acquaintance. The Sudra welcomed and adored the Rishi with due rites, and pleased him highly.

sa: अथ तं तापसं शूद्रः सोऽब्रवीद् भरतर्षभ। पितृकार्यं करिष्यामि तत्र मेऽनुग्रहं कुरु॥
en: On one of these occasions the Shudra, O king, addressing the Rishi, said I wish to perform the rites that are ordained for the Pitris. Do you show me kindness in this matter.

sa: क्रमेण वर्धितौ चापि विद्यासु कुशलावुभौ॥ अथर्ववेदे वेदे च बभूवर्षिः सुनिष्ठितः।
en: Both of them began to grow and both gained great knowledge in the usual branches of study. The Brahmana became well versed in the Vedas as also in the Atharvans.

sa: प्रिये वाप्यप्रिये वापि दुर्बले बलवत्यपि। यस्य नास्ति समं चक्षुः किं तस्मिन् मुक्तलक्षणम्॥१३२
en: What marks of Liberation exist in him who cannot look impartially on the agreeable, on the weak, and the strong? Unworthy as you are of it, your pretence to Liberation should be suppressed by your counsellors.

sa: विविक्ते पर्वततटे पाराशर्यो महातपाः। वेदानध्यापयामास व्यास: शिष्यान् महामतिः॥
en: At the foot of those mountains, in a retired spot, Parashara's son of great ascetic merit, viz., Vyasa, taught the Vedas to his disciples.

sa: देतत्कृते कर्मविधिः प्रवृत्तः। त्येतत्कृते ज्ञानविधिः प्रवृत्तः॥
en: The efforts for the acquisition of Knowledge, however, originate from a desire for avoiding both happiness and misery.

sa: एतत् सर्वं च पश्यामि त्वयि बुद्धिमतां वर। यच्चान्यदपि वेत्तव्यं तत्त्वतो वेद तद् भवान्॥
en: O foremost of intelligent persons, I see that all this knowledge that I am imparting to you, lives in you. Whatever else should be known by one desirous of learning the Religion of Liberation, is already known to you.

sa: पराशर उवाच प्रतिग्रहो याजनं च तथैवाध्यापनं नृप। विशेषधर्मा विप्राणां रक्षा क्षत्रस्य शोभना॥
en: Parashara said Taking gifts, officiating at the sacrifices of others, the teaching of pupils, O king, are the especial duties of the Brahmanas. The protection of the other castes is the special duty of the Kshatriya.

sa: ज्योतिरात्मनि नान्यत्र सर्वजन्तुषु तत् समम्। स्वयं च शक्यते द्रष्टुं सुसमाहितचेतसा॥
en: The effulgent ray exists in one's Soul and not any where else. It exists equally in all creatures. One can see it himself if his heart be given to Yoga.

sa: भीष्म उवाच अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। मनोः पजापतेर्वादं महर्षेश्च बृहस्पतेः॥
en: Bhishma said Regarding it is cited the old narrative of the conversation between that lord of creatures, viz., Manu, and the great Rishi Brihaspati.

sa: कल्याणं कुरुते बाढं धीमान् न ग्लायते क्वचित्। प्रशान्तवाङ्मना नित्यं ह्रीस्तु धर्मादवाप्यते॥
en: That virtue by which an intelligent man contended in mind and words performs mnany good deeds and is never blamed by others, is called modesty. It is acquired by the help of righteousness.

sa: नायं धारयते किञ्चिज्जिज्ञासा त्वत्कृते कृता। कालो धर्मस्तथा मृत्युः कामक्रोधौ तथा युवाम्॥ सर्वमन्योन्यनिष्कर्ष निघृष्टं पश्यतस्तव। गच्छ लोकान् जितान् स्वेन कर्मणा यत्रवाञ्छसि॥११७।
en: This Vikrita really does not owe me anything. We appealed to you for your own sake. Time, Dharma, Mrityu, and we two, have cxamined everything about you, here in your very presence, by creating this quarrel between you and that Brahmana. go now, as you like, to those regions of happiness which you have acquired by means of your deeds.

sa: राजोवाच जलमेतन्निपतितं मम पाणौ द्विजोत्तम। सममस्तु सहैवास्तु प्रतिगृह्णातु वै भवान्॥
en: The king said-These drops of water, see, O foremost of Brahmanas, have fallen upon my hand. I also wish to give you. Accept my gift. Let us both stand equal.

sa: तौ चोवाच स राजर्षिः कृतकार्यो गमिष्यथः। नेदानी मामिहासाद्य राजधर्मो भवेन्मृषा॥
en: The royal sage then said to the two disputants,-having acquired your respective objects, go you both. I should see that kingly duties, which are in me, may not become useless.

sa: प्लावयिता तस्य ज्ञानं प्लव इहोच्यते। विज्ञाय कृतकृत्यस्तु तीर्णस्तदुभयं त्यजेत्॥
en: The Preceptor is the helmsman, and Knowledge is the Boat. After having got that Boat, one becomes successful. Indeed, having crossed the Ocean, one may renounce both.

sa: स्वर्ग उवाच स्वर्ग मां विद्धि राजेन्द्र रूपिणं स्वयमागतम्। अविवादोऽस्तु युवयोरुभौ तुल्यफलौ युवाम्॥
en: Heaven said Know, O great king, that I am Heaven's self-incarnate, come here in person. Let this dispute between you cease. You are both equal in respect of the merit or rewards that you have acquired.

sa: सत्यमेकाक्षरं ब्रह्म सत्यमेकाक्षरं तपः। सत्यमेकाक्षरो यज्ञः सत्यमेकाक्षरं श्रुतम्॥
en: Truth is the one undecaying Brahma. Truth is the one undecaying Penance. Truth is the one undecaying Sacrifice. Truth is the one undecaying Veda.

sa: अनभिघ्या परस्वेषु सर्वसत्त्वेषु सौहृदम्। कर्मणां फलमस्तीति त्रिविधं मनसा चरेत्॥
en: Coveting the possessions of others, doing harm to others, and disbelief in the Vedas, are the three deeds done with the mind which should always be avoided.

sa: ब्राह्मणेभ्यः प्रदायाग्रं यः सुहृद्भिः सहाश्नुते। स प्रेत्य लभते स्वर्गमिह चानन्त्यमश्नुते॥
en: He, however, who dedicates the first portion of Brahmanas, and takes the residue, dividing it with friends and kinsmen acquires great felicity in the next world and infinite happiness here.

sa: को हि शक्तो गुणान् वक्तुं देवदेवस्य धीमतः। गर्भजन्मजरायुक्तो मर्यो मृत्युसमन्वितः॥
en: Who is there, who is competent to recount the virtues of that god of gods, who is gifted with supreme Intelligence? Man is subject to conception, birth, decrepitude, and death.

sa: अर्थात् प्रियतरत्वं च सर्वलोकेषु वै तदा। प्राप्तवानेव राजेन्द्र सुवर्णाक्षान्महेश्वरात्॥
en: O king of kings, it is through Maheshvara of celestial vision that Vasudeva has got the quality of universal agreeableness agreeableness which is much greater than riches.

sa: अधीत्य वेदं तपसा ब्रह्मचारी यज्ञाज्यशक्त्या संनिगृह्येह पञ्च। वनं गच्छेत् पुरुषो धर्मकामः श्रेयः स्थित्वा स्थापयित्वा स्ववंशम्॥
en: The man desirous of acquiring merit should at first study the Vedas and practise penances, becoming a Brahimacharin. He should next, becoming a householder, perform the usual Sacrifices. Establishing his race, he should then enter the forest, controlling his senses, and desirous of acquiring Liberation.

sa: एष शक्तो महाबाहुर्वक्तुं भगवतो गुणान्। विभूतिं चैव कात्स्न्र्थेन सत्यां माहेश्वरी नृप॥
en: This mightyarmed one of Yadu's race is alone competent to tell the qualities of the illustrious Shiva. Verily, O king, only he is able to describe fully the power of the Supreme god.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्त्वा तदा भीष्मो वासुदेवं महायशाः। भवमाहात्म्यसंयुक्तमिदमाह पितामहः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having said these words, the illustrious Bhishma, the grandfather of the Kurus, addressing Vasudeva, said the following words describing the greatness of Bhava, O king.

sa: न चैष तत्त्ववांस्तात निस्तत्त्वस्त्वेष बुद्धिमान्। एष मुञ्चति तत्त्वं हि क्षिप्रं बुद्धस्य लक्षणम्॥
en: Indeed, O son, the Soul not to be considered as possessed of any of the principles. Endued with Intelligence, it is above the principles. It renounces quickly even that principle which is the mark of Knowledge.

sa: यो ददाति सहस्राणि गवामश्वशतानि च। अभयं सर्वभूतेभ्यः सदा तमभिवर्तते॥
en: He who gives away thousands of kine and hundreds of horses, and who promises harmlessness to all creatures receives in return the promise of harmlessness from all.

sa: एवं कृतस्वस्त्ययनस्तयाऽहं ततोऽभ्यनुज्ञाय नरेन्द्रपुत्रीम्। पितुः समीपं नरसत्तमस्य मातुश्च राज्ञश्च तथाऽऽहकस्य॥ गत्वा समावेद्य यदब्रवीन्मां विद्याधरेन्द्रस्य सुता भृशार्ता। तानभ्यनुज्ञाय तदातिदुःखाद् गदं तथैवातिबलं च रामम्। अथोचतुः प्रीतियुतौ तदानीं तप:समृद्धिर्भवतोऽस्त्वविघ्नम्॥
en: Thus blessed by her, I took her leave, bidding farewell to the daughter of the prince of monkeys. Repairing them to the presence of that foremost of men, viz., my father, of my mother, of the king, and of Ahuka, I informed them of what the daughter of the king of the Vidyadharas, in great misery, had said to me. Bidding them farewell with a sorrowful heart, I then went to Gada and to Rama of great power.

sa: यथा तिलानामिह पुष्पसंश्रयात् पृथक्पृथग्याति गुणोऽतिसौम्यताम्। तथा नराणां भुवि भावितात्मनां यथाऽऽश्रयं सत्त्वगुणः प्रवर्तते॥
en: As sesame seeds, for being always with sweet-scented flowers, become in respect of quality very sweet, so the quality of Goodness arises in men proportionate to the extent of their association with persons of purified souls.

sa: मरणं जन्मनि प्रोक्तं जन्म वै मरणाश्रितम्। अविद्वान् मोक्षधर्मेषु बद्धो भ्रमति चक्रवत्। न धर्मकाल: पुरुषस्य
en: It has been said that death originates from birth. Birth is subject to the control of death. One unacquainted with the course of the duties of Liberation revolves like a wheel between birth and death, unable to free himself from that fate.

sa: गोब्राह्मणहितार्थं च वर्णानां संकरेषु च। वैश्यो गृह्णीत शस्त्राणि परित्राणार्थमात्मनः॥
en: For the good of Brahmanas and kine, and on occasions when mixture of castes takes place, even a Vaishya may take up weapons for his own safety.

sa: यथा समुद्रमभितः संश्रिताः सरितोऽपराः। तथाद्या प्रकृतिर्योगादभिसंश्रियते सदा॥
en: As all rivers running towards the ocean, join it, so the mind, when engaged in Yoga, becomes united with primal Nature.

sa: एतत् सर्वमशेषेण यथोक्तं परिवर्तयेत्। निवृत्तं मार्गमासाद्य व्यक्ताव्यक्तमनाश्रयम्॥
en: Follow the path of abstention, he should try to do away with his dependence on both the External and the Internal.

sa: विश्वावसुश्च गन्धर्वस्तथा तुम्बुरुनारदौ॥ हाहा हूहूच गन्धर्वी तुष्टवुः शुकसम्भवम्।
en: The Gandharvas Vishvavasu, and Tumvuru, and Narada, and those other Gandharvas called by the name of Haha, and Huhu, eulogised the birth of Shuka.

sa: जेगीयन्ते स्म गन्धर्वा ननृतुश्चाप्सरोगणाः॥ देवदुन्दुभयश्चैव प्रावाद्यन्त महास्वनाः।
en: The Gandharvas sang repeatedly and the various clans of Apsaras danced; and celestial kettle drums of loud sound began to bcat.

sa: योगेश्वरं देवगीतं वेस्थ कृष्ण न संशयः। तस्य चौपददौ पुत्रान् सहस्रं क्रतुसम्मितान्॥
en: Mahadeva granted him a thousand sons having qualifications proportionate to the merits of the sacrifice. Forsooth, you know, O Krishna, the Lord of Yoga, him who is, who is sung by the gods.

sa: समाहितं क्षणं किञ्चिद् ध्यानवर्त्मनि तिष्ठति। पुनर्वायुपथं भ्रान्तं मनो भवति वायुवत्॥
en: When fixed, for some time the inind stays in that path. When, however, it goes astray again into the path of the wind, it becomes as fleet as the wind.

sa: अशेत मुसलेष्वेव प्रसादार्थे भवस्य सा। तामब्रवीद्धसन् देवो भविता वै सुतस्तव॥
en: And all this time she slept on wooden clubs for picasing Bhava, The great god then appeared before her and then smilingly addressed her, saying You will have a son.

sa: न त्वेव बुध्यतेऽव्यक्तं सगुणं तात निर्गुणम्। कदाचित् त्वेव खल्वेतदाहुरप्रतिबुद्धकम्॥
en: The Unmanifest or Nature can at no time comprehend Brahma which is really without qualities even when it shows itself with qualities. Hence is Nature called Unintelligent.

sa: उभे चैते मते ज्ञाते नृपते शिष्टसम्मते। अनुष्ठिते यथाशास्त्रं नेयतां परमां गतिम्॥ तुल्यं शौचं तपोयुक्तं दया भूतेषु चानघ। व्रतानां धारणं तुल्यं दर्शनं न समं तयोः॥
en: agree with noth those systems of science, O king, so do the good and wise. If practised duly according to the instructions laid down, both would, O king, make a person acquire the highest end. In both systems purity is equally recommended as also mercy towards all creatures, O sinless one. In both, again, the observance of vows has been equally sanctioned. Only the scriptures which point out their paths are different.

sa: एते चान्ये च बहवः सगणा दैत्यदानवाः। धर्मसेतुमतिक्रम्य रेमिरेऽधर्मनिश्चयाः॥
en: Disregarding all restraints of duty and religion, these and many other Daityas and Danavas sported and found pleasure in all sorts of wicked acts.

sa: तत: स तुमुलं दृष्ट्वा तं च भूतमुपस्थितम्॥ महर्षिसुरगन्धर्वानुवाचेदं पितामहः।
en: Seeing that dreadful agitation of the universe and that Being originated from the sacrificial fire, the Grandfather said to the great Rishis, the gods, and the Gandharvas.

sa: सृजते हि गुणान् सत्त्वं क्षेत्रज्ञः परिपश्यति। सम्प्रयोगस्तयोरेष सत्त्वक्षेत्रज्ञयोधुवः॥
en: The understanding or Intelligence creates all the qualities. The Soul only sees them. Such is certainly the connection between the Intelligence and the Soul.

sa: विष्णुर्मरीचये प्रादान्मरीचिर्भगवानपि॥ महर्षिभ्यो ददौ खड्गमृषयो वासवाय च।
en: Vishnu gave it to Marichi. The divine Marichi gave it to all the great Rishis. the latter gave it to Vasava.

sa: अवमानस्तथा मोहः प्रमादः स्वप्नतन्द्रिता। कथंचिदभिवर्तन्ते विविधास्तामसा गुणाः॥
en: Disgrace, delusion, error, slcep and stupefaction, that befall one through excess of ill-luck, are various properties of the state of Jgnorance.

sa: अपरे दानवा भग्नाः खड्गपातावपीडिताः॥ अन्योन्यमभिनर्दन्तो दिशः सम्प्रतिपेदिरे।
en: Stricken with strokes of the sword, other Danavas broke and fled in all directions, cheering up one another as they fled.

sa: धर्मो योनिर्मनुष्याणां देवानाममृतं दिवि। प्रेत्यभावे सुखं धर्माच्छश्चत्तैरुपभुज्यते॥
en: Righteousness is the origin of mankind. Righteousness is the nectar of the gods. After death, men enjoy, through Righteousness, eternal felicity.

sa: त्वंकारं नामधेयं च ज्येष्ठानां परिवर्जयेत्। अवराणां समानानामुभयेषां न दुष्यति॥
en: One should never Thou-Thee their elders, while addressing them, nor take their names. Thou-,thee-,ing, or taking of names, is only allowable in addressing inferiors or one's compeers.

sa: योगमार्ग तथाऽऽसाद्य यः कश्चिद् व्रजते द्विजः। क्षेमेणोपरमेन्मार्गाद् बहुदोषो हि स स्मृतः॥
en: Like such a path few Brahmanas can walk along the Yoga-path with ease and comfort. That man who, having followed this path, ceases to go forward is considered as guilty of many faults.

sa: ये गुरून् पर्युपासन्ते नियता ब्रह्मचारिणः। पन्थानं सर्वलोकानां विजानन्ति मनीषिणः॥
en: Those wise men who with vows and observing Brahmacharya listen with reverence to the instructions of preceptors, can learn the ends reserved for all classes of men.

sa: संचिनोत्यशुभं कर्म कलत्रापेक्षया नरः। तत: क्लेशमवाप्नोति परत्रेह तथैव च॥
en: Man commits numerous evil deeds for the sake of his wife. From those evil deeds he suffers much distress both in this world and in the next.

sa: इह वार्ता बहुविधा धर्माधर्मस्य कारिणः। यस्तद्वेदोभयं प्राज्ञः पाप्मना न स लिप्यते॥
en: Here various opinions are advanced by those who do virtuous or sinful deeds. That wise man who knows all those opinions which may be divided into two sorts, is never sullied by sin.

sa: श्वापि महेश्वरवचनाद् भवामि स हि नः परः कामः। त्रिदशगणराज्यमपि खलु नेच्छाभ्यमहेश्वराज्ञप्तम्।।
en: At the word, of Hara I would become even a dog. In fact, that is my highest wish. If not given by Maheshvara, I would not have the sovereignty of the very gods.

sa: तुल्यतामिह पश्यामि सदृशोऽहमनेन वै। अयं हि विमलो व्यक्तमहमीदृशकस्तथा॥
en: I see my similarity with Him. I am, indeed, like Him. He is pure. It is clear that I am of the same nature.

sa: ज्ञानं ज्ञेयेषु भिन्नेषु यदा भेदेन वर्तते। तत्रातिशायिनी बुद्धिस्तत् सौक्ष्म्यमिति वर्तते॥
en: When knowledge rests on difference from one another, and when the understanding rests upon many points one after another, the combination of words is said to be sullied by ambiguity.

sa: ऋषीणामभिगम्यश्च सूत्रकर्ता सुतस्तव। मत्प्रसादाद् द्विजश्रेष्ठ भविष्यति न संशयः॥
en: All the Rishis shall seek you, and your son, through my favour, shall become the author of Sutras, O foremost of twice born ones.

sa: दानं तु द्विविधं प्राहुः परत्रार्थमिहैव च। सद्भ्यो यद् दीयते किंचित् तत्परत्रोपतिष्ठते॥
en: Gift is said to be of two sorts : gifts for the other world, and those for this. Whatever is given to the good yields fruits to the giver in the other world.

sa: एवमभ्याहते लोके कालेनोपनिपीडिते। सुमहद् धैर्यमालम्ब्य धर्मं सर्वात्मना कुरु॥
en: When, therefore, the world is thus assailed by Death, do you, with your whole heart, achieve virtue, helped all the while by unswerving patience.

sa: योऽर्थो धर्मेण संयुक्तो धर्मो यश्चार्थसंयुतः। तद्धि त्वामृतसंवादं तस्मादेतौ मताविह॥
en: That Wealth which is connected with Virtue, as also that Virtue which is connected with Wealth, is certainly like ambrosia. For this reason we hold these opinions.

sa: पृथिवी सर्वभूताना जनित्री तद्विधाः स्त्रियः! पुमान् प्रजापतिस्तत्र शुक्रं तेजोमयं विदुः॥
en: The Earth gives birth of all creatures. Females partake of her nature. The male animal is like Prajapati himself. The seminal fluid, it should be known, is the creative energy.

sa: श्वः कार्यमद्य कुर्वीत पूर्वाह्ने चापराह्निकम्। न हि प्रतीक्षते मृत्युः कृतं वास्य न वाकृतम्॥
en: Do that today which you would keep for tomorrow. Do that in the forenoon which you would keep for the afternoon. Death does not wait for any one, to seen whether one has or has not done his task.

sa: स्रष्टारं भुवनस्येह वदन्तीह पितामहम्। आराध्य स तु देवेशमश्नुते महतीं श्रियम्॥
en: The wise say that the Grandfather Brahman is the creator of this universe. Brahman, however, got his great power and prosperity by worshipping and gratifying Mahadeva, that God of gods.

sa: किं चात्र बहुभिः सूक्तैर्हेतुवादैः पुरंदर सहस्त्रनयनं दृष्ट्वा त्वामेव सुरसत्तम॥
en: What necessity, O Purandara, is there of giving vent to tall talks full of sophistry when I see you a thousand eyes, O best of the gods.

sa: अविस्रम्भे न गन्तव्यं विस्रम्भे धारयेन्मनः। मनः प्राणे निगृह्णीयात् प्राणं ब्रह्मणि धारयेत्॥
en: If there is no faith, one will never attain to that subtile sense. One should, therefore cherish faith. The mind should be associated with Prana, and Prana should then be held within Brahma.

sa: इत्येते चतुरो वर्णा येषां ब्राह्मी सरस्वती। विहिता ब्रह्मणा पूर्वं लोभात् त्वज्ञानतां गताः॥
en: Thus were the four castes at first created equally by Brahman who ordained for all of them the observances described (in the Vedas). Cupidity alone brought about the fall of many, who were possessed by ignorance.

sa: भृगुरुवाच न विशेषोऽस्ति वर्णानां सर्वं ब्राह्ममिदं जगत्। ब्रह्मणा पूर्वसृष्टं हि कर्मभिर्वर्णतां गतम्॥
en: Bhrigu said There is in fact no distinction between the different castes. The whole world at first consisted of Brahmanas. Created equally by Brahman, men have, on account of their acts, been divided into various castes.

sa: शिष्टं तत्र मनस्तात इन्द्रियाणि च भारत। आगच्छन्ति यथाकालं गुरोः संदेशकारिणः॥
en: These remains, O son, only the mind with the senses, O Bharata. These have to return once more at the appointed time for satisfying the command of their great Master.

sa: तस्माद् धर्मप्रधानेन साध्योऽर्थः संयतात्मना। विश्वस्तेषु हि भूतेषु कल्पते सर्वमेव हि॥
en: One should, therefore, try to acquire Wealth with a devoted mind, without neglecting the requirements of Virtue. They who have faith in this injunction succeed in gaining whatever they desire.

sa: कस्मादोषधिसम्पत्तिः को वा धारयते वसु। प्रकामं क्रीडते को वा त्रैलोक्ये सचराचरे॥
en: From whom else do we get our precious herbs? Who else upholds all kinds of riches. Who else sports as much as he likes in the three worlds of mobile and immobile things?

sa: यदा तु गुणजालं तदव्यक्तात्मनि संक्षिपेत्। तदा सह गुणैस्तैस्तु पञ्चविंशो विलीयते॥
en: When the Yogin withdraws and merges all the principles into the Unmanifest Soul (or Brahma), then the twenty-fifth (viz., Soul or Purusha) also, with all those principles, disappears into it.

sa: यत्र खं तत्र पवनस्तत्राग्निर्यत्र मारुतः। अमूर्तयस्ते विज्ञेया मूर्तिमन्तः शरीरिणाम्॥
en: There is wind where space is, and there is fire where is. They have in reality no forms, and become endued with form only in embodied creatures.

sa: शेषमल्पं दिनानां ते दक्षिणायनभास्करे। आवृते भगवत्यर्के गन्तासि परमां गतिम्॥
en: You have very few days to live. When the Sun turns from his southern solstice for entering into the northern, you will attain to your high end.

sa: तस्मिन् पञ्चत्वमापन्ने जीवः किमनुधावति। किं वेदयति वा जीवः किं शृणोति ब्रवीति च॥
en: When the five ingredients of the body which is a compound of the five elements, are separated, where does life go? What does it then know. What does it then hear? What does it then say?

sa: धर्मार्थकामाः सममेव सेव्या यो होकभक्तः स नरो जघन्यः। तयोस्तु दाक्ष्यं प्रवदन्ति मध्यं स उत्तमो योऽभिरतस्त्रिवर्गे॥
en: Virtue, Profit, and Desire should all be equally pursued. That man who follows only one of them is certainly not a superior person. He is middling who follows only two of them. He, on the other hand, is the best who follows all the three.

sa: प्राज्ञः सुहृच्चन्दनसारलिप्तो विचित्रमाल्याभरणैरुपेतः। ततो वचः संग्रहविस्तरेण प्रोक्त्वाथ वीरान् विरराम भीमः॥
en: Having said these words both briefly and fully, to those heroes, Bhima endued with wisdom, surrounded by friends smeared with sandal-paste, and decorated with beautiful garlands and ornaments, remained silent.

sa: अग्निः पवनसंयुक्तः खं समाक्षिपते जलम्। सोऽग्निमारुतसंयोगाद्घनत्वमुपपद्यते॥
en: Helped by the wind, fore combined Space and Water. In fact, combining with the wind, fire became solidified.

sa: स्नेहेन युक्तस्य न चास्ति मुक्तिरिति स्वयम्भूर्भगवानुवाच। बुधाश्च निर्वाणपरा भवन्ति तस्मान्न कुर्यात् प्रियमप्रियं च॥
en: The Self-sprung and divine Brahman has said that there is no liberation for him who is fettered with ties of attachment and love. The learned, however, seek Extinction. Therefore, one should never regard anything as either pleasant or unpleasant.

sa: एतत् प्रधानं च न कामकारो यथा नियुक्तोऽस्मि तथा करोमि। भूतानि सर्वाणि विधिनियुङ्क्ते विधिर्वलीयानिति वित्त सर्वे॥
en: This view seems to be the best. Not one in this world can act as he likes. I act precisely as I am made to do. The great Creator makes all creatures move as He wills. The Creator is Supreme. Know this, all of you.

sa: समवैक्षत तं विप्रो ज्ञानदीभ्रुण चक्षुषा। ददर्श चैनं देवानां देवमिन्द्रं शचीपतिम्॥
en: With eye whose vision was extended by knowledge, the Brahmana then saw that being who had addressed him as Indra the king on the gods and the lord of Shachi.

sa: यदि ब्रह्मशृणोष्येतच्छ्रद्दधासि च मे वचः। वेदोक्तस्यैव धर्मस्य फलं मुख्यमवाप्स्यसि॥
en: If, O twice-born one, you listen to me and confide in my words, you will acquire the highest reward of the religion laid down in the Vedas.

sa: स्वायम्भुवाद्या मनवो भृग्वाद्या ऋषयस्तथा। शक्राद्या देवताश्चैव सर्व एव समभ्ययुः॥
en: The Munis headed by the Self create Manu, and the Rishis having Bhrigu for their first, and the gods with Shakra at their head, all came there.

sa: प्रज्ञया प्रापितार्थो हि बलिरैश्वर्यसंक्षये। प्रह्लादो नमुचिर्मङ्किस्तस्याः किं विद्यते परम्॥
en: It was through wisdom that Vali, Prahlada, Namuchi, and Manki, when they lost their prosperity, succeeded in gaining happiness, What is there that is superior to wisdom.

sa: तस्य क्षयमुपागम्य ततो भिक्षामयाचत। प्रतिश्रयं च वासार्थं भिक्षां चैवाथ वार्षिकीम्॥
en: Going to the house of that robber, the Brahmana begged for alms. Indeed, he prayed for a house to live in and the necessaries of life lasting for a year.

sa: तत: प्रीतो महादेवः सपत्नीको वृषध्वजः। अब्रवीत् त्रिदशांस्तत्र हर्षयन्निव मां तदा॥ पश्यध्वं त्रिदशाः सर्वे उपमन्योर्महात्मनः। मयि भक्तिं परां नित्यमेकभावादवस्थिताम्॥
en: Then Mahadeva accompanied by his wife, and having the bull for his emblem, having been pleased with me, addressed the deities assembled there in these words, filling me with great joy Behold, your gods, the devotion of the great Upamanyu. Indeed, steady and great is that devotion, and entirely fixed, for it remains unaltered.

sa: अनया चैव भक्त्या ते अत्यर्थे प्रीतिमानहम्। तस्मात्सर्वान्ददाम्यद्य कामांस्तव यथेप्सितान्॥
en: I have been very highly pleased with you on account of this your devotion to Shiva. I Shall, therefore, give you today the fruition of your desires.

sa: सर्गकोटिसहस्राणि मरणान्तासु मूर्तिषु। य एवं कुरुते कर्म शुभाशुभफलात्मकम्॥ स एव फलमाप्नोति त्रिषु लोकेषु मूर्तिमान्। प्रकृति कुरुते कर्म शुभाशुभफलात्मकम्। प्रकृतिश्च तद श्नाति त्रिषु लोकेषु कामगा॥ तिर्यग्योनिमनुष्यत्वं देवलोके तथैव च। त्रीणि स्थानानि चैतानि जानीयात् प्रकृतानि ह॥ अलिङ्गां प्रकृति त्वाहुर्लिङ्गैरनुमिमीमहे। तथैव पौरुषं लिङ्गमनुमानाद्धि मन्यते॥
en: Millions upon millions of births have to be gone through by Individual Soul in the successive forms he assumes, all of which are liable to death. He who does acts in this way, which are all full of good and bad fruits, has in the three worlds to assume successive forms and to enjoy and suffer fruits corresponding therewith. It is Nature that causes good and bad acts; and it is Nature that enjoys and suffers the fruits thereof in the three worlds. Indeed, Nature follows the course of acts. The status of the intermediate beings, of humanity, and of the gods, all originate from Nature. Nature has been said to be shorn of all qualities. Her existence is proved by her acts.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एतच्छ्रुत्वा महाराज धृतराष्ट्रोऽम्बिकासुतः। शोकस्यान्तमपश्यन् वै हतं मेने सुयोधनम्॥ विह्वलः पतितो भूमौ नष्टचेता इव द्विपः।
en: Vaishampayana said Having heard this (the above intelligence), the great king Dhritarashtra, the son of Ambika, experienced, indeed, the farthest limit of grief and considered Suyodhana slain (in the battle); and highly perturbed, he fell down upon the ground, like an elephant, that had lost all his senses.

sa: खं पूरयन् महावेगान् खगमान् गृध्रवाससः। सुवर्णविकृतांश्चित्रान् मुमोचाधिरथिः शरान्॥
en: Filling the sky, the son of Adhiratha showered arrows decked with gold and furnished with vulturine feathers, that ranged variously through the entire welkin.

sa: शरांश्च शतधा तस्य द्रोणश्चिच्छेद सायकैः। ध्वजं धनुश्च निशितैः सारथिं चाप्यपातयत्॥
en: Then with his own arrows Drona cut-off those of Dhristadyumna in hundred pieces and then with sharp arrows he felled the standard, the bow and the charioteer of the latter.

sa: वसातयो महाराज द्विसासस्त्राः प्रहारिणः। शूरसेनाश्च विक्रान्ताः सर्वे युधि निपातिताः॥
en: O great monarch, the great smiters of foes, the two thousand Vashati troops, as well as all the Surashenas possessed of great prowess, were slain in battle.

sa: कौन्येनाग्रतः सृष्टा न्यपतन् पृष्ठतः शराः। तूर्णात् तूर्णतरं हाश्वाः प्रावहन् वातरंहसः॥
en: The arrows discharged by the son of Kunti began to fall behind him, so quickly did those steeds, endowed with the fleetness of the wind, bear that chariot of his.

sa: मुञ्चश्चेषुगणांस्तीक्ष्णाल्लँघुहस्तो दृढव्रतः॥ अभिदुद्राव राजानं सिंहो मृगमिवोल्बणः।
en: By discharging numerous sharp arrows and like a fierce lion assailing a deer, he then assailed the king.

sa: तस्य त्वहानि चत्वारि क्षपा चैकास्यतो गता। तस्य चाह्नस्त्रिभागेन क्षयं जग्मुः पतत्रिणः॥
en: His weapons had not been exhausted although he had used them for four days and one night; on the expiration of the third part of the fifth day, his stock of arrows exhausted.

sa: चित्रसेनो महाराज शतानीकं पुनर्युधि। नवभिर्निशितैर्बाणैराजधान स्तनान्तरे॥
en: Once again, in that engagement Chitrasena, ( mighty monarch, pierced Satanika in the chest with nine keen darts.

sa: निवार्य तान् बाणगणैर्युधि राजन् धनंजयः। जघान तावकान् योधान् वज्रपाणिरिवासुरान्॥
en: O monarch, baffling the countless shafts shot by his foes, Dhananjaya slew the warriors of your army with excellent shafts charged with the force of the thunder.

sa: उवाच चैनं पुत्रस्ते संरम्भाद् रक्तलोचनः॥ ससम्भ्रममिदं वाक्यमब्रवीत् कुरुनन्दनः।
en: And endued with the fleetness of the wind or thought, dashed towards Drona. Then your son with eyes red in rage addressing Drona said

sa: समन्तपञ्चकादस्माद् बहिर्वानरकेतन॥ तस्माजयद्रथस्य त्वं शिरश्छित्त्वा महामृधे।
en: Outside the precincts of the Samantapanchaka, o ape-bononered one. Therefore, severing Jayadratha's head in this terrible fight, you.

sa: ननाद च महानादं पूरयन्निव मेदिनीम्। अर्जुनः शकुनेश्चापं सायकैरच्छिनद् रणे॥
en: Uttered a mighty roar that filled the earth with its echo. Thereafter that son of the foremost of celestials, cut-off the bow of Sakuni with his arrows.

sa: शस्त्रमाच्छिद्य शत्रूणां सायुधानां निरायुधाः॥ तेनैवैतानमोधास्त्रा निघ्नन्ति च नदन्ति च।
en: Themselves although without any arms they are carrying away the arms of the enemies (from their hands) and with them they are killing foes and making war-caries.

sa: परिवQर्महात्मानं परीप्सन्तो यदूत्तमम्। ततः प्रववृते युद्धं द्रोणस्य सह पाण्डवैः॥
en: With the desire of rescuing the high-souled perpetuator of the Yadu race surrounded him on all sides. Then there commenced a battle between Drona and the Pandavas,

sa: हत्वैन पुनरायाति नागानन्यान् प्रहारिणः॥ पश्य नीलाम्बुदनिभान् महासात्रैरधिष्ठितान्। शक्तितोमरसंघातैविनिघ्नन्तं वृकोदरम्॥
en: Killing him he is proceeding against other elephants resembling a mass of dark blue clouds and driven by riders. They are striking Vrikodara with Saktis and Tomaras.

sa: तथैव पौरवो राजा नागायुतबलो महान्। समरे पाण्डुपुत्रेण निहतः सव्यसाचिना॥
en: In the same way, the great king Paurava, possessing the power of the thousand clephants, was slain with all his attendants by Savyasachin, the son of Pandu.

sa: स भवांस्त्रातु नो द्रोणात् सत्याज्ज्यायोऽनृतं वचः। अनृतं जीवितस्यार्थे वदन्न स्पृश्यतेऽनृतैः॥
en: Save us from Drona; under the circumstances as the present falsehood is better than truth. Speaking falsehood for the sake of saving a life one does not become a sinner.

sa: युध्यमानस्य भीमस्य सूतपुत्रोऽसमायया। तस्येषुधी धनुर्ध्या च बाणैः संनतपर्वभिः॥ रश्मीन् योक्त्राणि चाश्वानां क्रुद्धः कर्णोऽच्छिनन्मृधे। तस्याश्वांश्च पुनर्हत्वा सूतं विव्याध पञ्चभिः॥
en: Inflamed with wrath, Karna, the son of Suta by virtue of the illusion of his weapons, cut-off in that combat, with his straight arrows the pairs of quivers and the bow-string and the traces of the steeds of the fighting Bhima. Thereafter slaying his antagonist's steeds, Karna pierced the latter's charioteer with five shafts.

sa: विप्रकीर्णान्यनेकानि न हि तिष्ठन्ति कर्हिचित्। वातेनेव समूद्धृतमभ्रजालं विदीर्यते॥
en: O mighty monarch, this son of Pritha will completely crush our mighty host. Many troops are already scattered and none stays on the field.

sa: तस्मात् सम्पश्यतस्तस्य द्रावयिष्यामि वाहिनीम्। विद्राव्य सर्वान् हन्तास्मि जाल्मं पाझाल्यमेव तु॥
en: For that reason I shall crush his army even before his very eyes. Shattering the ranks of the hostile aimy I will slay the sinful son of the Panchala king

sa: प्रावर्तत नदी घोरा शोणितौघतरङ्गिणी। उभयोः सेनयोर्मध्ये नराश्वद्विपवाहिनी॥
en: A dreadful river of boldly currents began to flow between the two armies, carrying with it slain men horses and elephants.

sa: अस्तमेति महाबाहो त्वरमाणो दिवाकरः॥ एतद्धि पुरुषव्याघ्र महदभ्युद्यतं मया। कार्य संरक्ष्यते चैष कुरुसेनामहारथैः॥ तथा नाभ्येति सूर्योऽस्तं यथा सत्यं भवेद् वचः। चोदयाश्वांस्तथा कृष्ण यथा हन्यां जयद्रथम्॥
en: O mighty-armed one, the orb of the day, is quickly going towards the Western hills. O foremost of men, I have undertaken to achieve a mighty task. But the ruler of the Sindhus on the other hand is protected by many foremnost warriors among the Kurus. O Krishna, do you drive the horses in such a manner that my vow may be fulfilled before sunset and that Jayadratha may be slain. were

sa: कृतवर्मा तु हार्दिक्य: शैनेयं निशितैः शरैः। अवाकिरत्सुसंक्रुद्धस्ततोऽक्रुद्ध्यत्स सात्यकिः॥
en: Then Hridika's son Kritavarman inflamed with wrath, covered the grandson of Sini with clouds of whetted arrows. Thereupon Satyaki also became excited with rage.

sa: तं हतं पतितं ज्ञात्वा धृष्टद्युम्नो महारथः॥ द्रौणेः सकाशाद् राजेन्द्र व्यपनिन्ये रथोत्तमम्।
en: Seeing him fallen down and taking him for dead, the great car-warrior Dhristadyumna. placed him upon another car and bore him away from the presence of the son of Drona, O king kings.

sa: सूतपुत्रोऽपि कौन्तेयं शरैः संनतपर्वभिः। पञ्चाशता महाबाहुर्विव्याध भरतर्षभ॥
en: The son of Suta O foremost of the Bharatas, the mighty-armed hero, pierced Kunti's son with fifty arrows of depressed knots.

sa: द्रोणे तु निहते वीरे रथव्याने नरर्षभे। के वा मुखमनीकानामासन् संजय भागशः॥
en: When that hero, that foremost of the carwarriors, that best among men, Drona was slain (in battle), who, O Sanjaya, had been the leaders of the several divisions of the army in succession?

sa: ततो जनार्दनः संख्ये प्रिय पुरुषसत्तमम्। असम्भ्रान्तो महाबाहुरर्जुनं वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: Then as the battle progressed, the mighty armed and dauntless Janardana addressing his dear friend, that foremost of men (Arjuna), thus spokeउदपानमिहाश्वानां नालमस्ति रणेऽर्जुन।

sa: रथघोषः स संग्रामे पाण्डवेयस्य सम्बभौ। वासवाशनितुल्यस्य मेघौघस्येव मारिष॥
en: In that fight the rattling noise of the wheels of the car of Pandu's son, sounded, O sire, like the rumbling of Vasava's thunder.

sa: तस्मिन् क्षणे नरश्रेष्ठ गजवाजिजनक्षयः॥ प्रादुरीसादुभयतो राजन् मध्यगतेऽहनि।
en: Then, O best of men, countless men, horses and elephant of both parties fell just when the sun ascended the meridian.

sa: ओघवांश्च महाराज बृहन्तः सहितौ रणे। पराक्रमन्तौ मित्रार्थे गतौ वैवस्वतक्षयम्॥
en: O powerful monarch, Aghovat and Vrihantha, both exerting themselves in battle and displaying their prowess for the sake of their friends, departed to the region of Death.

sa: अब्रुवन् कर्ण युध्यस्व कत्थसे बहु सूतज। अनुक्त्वा विक्रमेद् यस्तु तद् वै सत्पुरुषव्रतम्॥
en: O Karna, O charioteer's son, you boast too much (of your prowess). Be engaged in fight. It is the duty of good (i.e. really brave) men to display their prowess without uttering (a single boastful word).

sa: विषाणगात्राफरयोधपातिना गजेन हन्तुं शकुनि कुलिन्दजः। जगाम् वेगेन भृशार्दयंश्च तं ततोऽस्य गान्धारपतिः शिरोऽहरत्॥
en: The second son of Kulinda attacked on Shakuni by the elephant capable to knock down the great warriors through his teeth, body and trunk and severally injured him. Shakuni, the king of Gandharva then beaded him.

sa: भीमसेनः समाकीरें द्रौणिना निशितैः शरैः। रराज समरे राजन् रश्मिवानिव भास्करः॥
en: O monarch. Bhimasenc, having been closed with a shower of keen arrows by the son of Drona, shone in the field of battle like the sun with all his rays.

sa: तान् दृष्ट्वा पततस्तूर्णं शैनेयः परवीरहा। प्रत्यगृह्णान्महाबाहुः प्रमुञ्चन् विशिखान् बहून्॥
en: Beholding then those heroes make towards himself in fury, that slayer of hostile heroes, that mighty-armed grandson of Shini, received them with a copious discharge of arrows.

sa: ततः प्रहस्याधिरथिः शरजालानि मारिष। प्रेषयामास समरे शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः॥
en: Thereupon, O sire, the son of Adhiratha, after smiling from a time, shot forth hundreds and thousands of shafts in the field of battle.

sa: इत्यन्तरिक्षे शतशृङ्गमूर्ध्नि तपस्विनां शृण्वतां वागुवाच। एवंविधं तच नाभूत तथा च देवापि नूनमनृतं वदन्ति॥
en: Even that celestial voice resounding in the skies reached the ears of the Maharsis living on the peaks of the Satasringa mountains. But now that voice comes to be untrue. It seems, therefore, that the gods too speak falsehood.

sa: मद्रराजः कथं शल्यो नियुक्तो रथिनां वरः। वैकर्तनस्य सारथ्ये तन्ममाचक्ष्व संजय॥
en: O Sanjaya, do you relate to me, how Shalya, the king of the Madras, that best among all the car-warriors, was engaged as the charioteer of the son of Vikartana?

sa: शृणु राजन् यदकरोत् तव सैन्येषु वीर्यवान्। अतीत्य स महाराज द्रोणानीकमहार्णवम्॥
en: Hear, O king, what feats were achieved by that hero endued with great propwess, at the cost of your troops. O mighty monarch, passing through the ocean-like host of Drona.

sa: तान् बाणांस्तव पुत्रोऽपि छित्त्वैकैकं त्रिभिः शरैः। ननाद सुमहानादं दारयाणो वसुन्धराम्॥
en: Your son, too, having severed every one of these arrows with three shafts of his own, sent out a great uproar; and thereby caused the whole earth echo with it.

sa: ततः पार्थो धनुश्छित्त्वा विव्याधैनं स्तनान्तरे। सायकैनवभिवीरस्त्वरमाणो धनंजयः॥
en: Then Pritha's son busting his bow open, pierced him on his chariot with nine arrows of depressed knots, with great speed.

sa: कृष्णसर्पो यथा मुक्तो वल्मीकं नृपसत्तम। तथात्यगान्महीं बाणो भित्त्वा कैकेयमाहवे॥
en: Like, O best of kings, black snakes freed from their sloughs, entering into their holes in anthills, those arrows penetrating through the Kekaya prince entered the earth.

sa: द्रौपदेयान् महाबाहुः पञ्चभिः पञ्चभिः शरैः। विराटं मत्स्यमष्टाभिर्दुपदं दशभिः शरैः॥
en: That mighty armed one (then pierced) each of (the five) sons of Draupadi with five arrows, Virata the king of Matsyas with eight, Drupada with ten darts.

sa: कचिद् द्रोणो न नः सर्वान् क्षपयेत् परमास्रवित्। समिद्धः शिशिरापाये दहन कक्षमिवानलः॥
en: "Is not Drona that warrior well-versed in the use of cxcellent weapons going to consume us all, like a raging conflagration consuming a heap of straw at the expiration of the winter season?

sa: तथा तेषु विषक्तेषु सैन्येषु जयगृद्धिषु। अर्जुनो वासुदेवश्च सैन्धवायैव जग्मतुः॥
en: Thus when the troops inflamed with the hopes of victory were fighting together, Arjuna and Vasudeva proceeded towards the spot where the ruler of the Sindhus were.

sa: तामापतन्तीमालक्ष्य भीमसेनो महागदाम्। शरैरवारयद् राजन् सर्वसैन्यस्य पश्यतः॥
en: Beholding that mace towards himself with great impetuosity, Vrikodara repulsed it with his arrows before the eyes of all the troops.

sa: ते राज्ञा चोदिता वीरा योत्स्यमाना महारथाः॥ क्षात्रधर्मं पुरस्कृत्य त्वरिता द्रोणमभ्ययुः।
en: Urged on by the king in the above manner. Those brave and mighty car-warriors engaged on the field, quickly rushed upon Drona, keeping in view the duties of the Kshatriyas.

sa: क्षात्रधर्मं पुरस्कृत्य सर्व एव गतज्वराः॥ जयन्तो वध्यमानाश्च गतिमिष्टां गमिष्यथ।
en: Keeping in view the duties of the Kshatriya order and dismissing your fears, engage in the battle; for then conquering or slain, you will obtain desirable ends.

sa: हत्वा पाण्डुसुतानाजौ सकृष्णान् सहसात्वतान्। गर्जामि यद्यहं विप्र तव किं तत्र नश्यति॥
en: That is (if wishing in my mind) to slay in battle the son of Pandu together with Krishna and Sattvata, I roar thus, what harm is there in it to you, O Brahmana?

sa: अहं धनुष्मान् ससुरासुरांश्च सर्वाणि भूतानि च सङ्गतानि। स्वबाहुवीर्याद् गमये पराभवं मत्पौरुषं विद्धि परं परेभ्यः॥
en: With the bow in my hand and with the strength of my capacious arms, I can outlive the Asuras, the celestials and all the other creatures grouped together, know it for certain, that my prowess surpasses to that of the most powerful.

sa: सोऽतिविद्धो महाराज कैकेयो द्रोणसायकैः। क्रोधेन महताऽऽविष्टो व्यावृत्य नयने शुभे॥
en: Then, O mighty monarch, deeply pierced with the arrows of Drona, the Kaikaya prince excited to the highest pitch of fury began to roll his charming eyes.

sa: तीर्णप्रतिज्ञं बीभत्सुं परिष्वज्यैनमब्रवीत्। दिष्ट्या सम्पादिता जिष्णो प्रतिज्ञा महती त्वया॥
en: Embraced Vibhatsu, who had fulfilled his promise and addressed him thus-"O Jishnu, it is by good fortune that you have been able to accomplish your great vow.

sa: मासेऽपतिष्यः पञ्चमे त्वं सुकृच्छ्रे न वा गर्भे आभविष्यः पृथायाः॥ तत् ते श्रेयो राजपुत्राभविष्यन्न चेत् संग्रामदपयानं दुरात्मन्।
en: It would have been better had come out in the fifth months as an abortion, or better still, if you would not have taken your being in the womb of Kunti, than, O vile wretch, being born of a royal line, to show your back in the battle-field.

sa: पीतानि शस्राण्यसृगुक्षितानि वीरावधूतानि तनुच्छदानि। दीप्तां प्रभां प्राजनयन्त तत्र तपात्यये विद्युदिवान्तरिक्षे॥
en: Well-tempered and beautiful weapons dyed with blood and wielded by the warriors shed a blazing lustre like flashes of lightning in the firmament at the end of the hot season.

sa: चित्रं सम्प्रेक्ष्य निहतं तावका रणशोभिनः। अभ्यद्रवन्त वेगेन प्रतिविन्ध्यं समन्ततः॥
en: Having seen Chitra slain (in the battle), the troops on your side, who are all ornaments of battle, rushed from all sides with great impetuosity against Pritivindhya.

sa: अगम्यरूपं च शरैराकाशं समपद्यत॥ तत्राप्यधिकमालक्ष्य माधवं रथसत्तमम्।
en: Clouded therewith, the sky sky became invisible. Then beholding that foremost of carwarriors, namely, him of Madhu's race, prevail over Duryodhana.

sa: ततोदुःशासनो राजन् विद्ध्वा पाण्डुसुतं रणे। सारथिं नवभिर्बाणैर्माद्रेयस्य समार्पयत्॥
en: Thereupon, O monarch, Dushasana, having pierced the son of Pandu in that battle, had struck the charioteer of the Madraya chief with nine shafts.

sa: भ्रातरश्चास्य बलिन: सर्वानेषु कृतश्रमाः॥ गुरुवृत्तिरताः प्राज्ञा धर्मनित्या यशस्विनः।
en: His brother (also) are powerful, well-skilled in all the weapons, devoted to the ministrations of their elders, wise, renowned and (they) always practice righteousness.

sa: तमभ्यधावन् क्रोशन्तः क्षत्रिया जयकाक्षिणः। इदं छिद्रमिति ज्ञात्वा धरणीस्थं धनंजयम्॥
en: Beholding Dhananjaya on the ground and taking this to be a meet opportunity, the Kshatriyas, desirous of obtaining victory and uttering load roars, rushed upon the former.

sa: संरब्धानां प्रवीराणां समरे दृढकर्मणाम्। तत्रासीत् सुमहाशब्दस्तुमुलो लोमहर्षणः॥
en: Do you so act, as they may proceed easily towards the chariot of Jayadratha. Speaking thus, they urged their troops on.

sa: ततः प्रववृते युद्धं कुरुमाधवसिंहयोः॥ अन्योन्यं क्रुद्धयो?रं यथा द्विरदसिंहयोः।
en: Then ensued a dreadful battle between those two foremost of Kuru's and Madhu's race, that resembled an encounter between a lion and an elephant.

sa: विनिकीर्णानि वीराणामनीकेषु समन्तताः। वस्त्राभरणशस्त्राणि ध्वजवर्मायुधानि च॥
en: In every division of heroic warriors, garments ornaments standards, armours and weapons were scen scattered in all directions.

sa: तमायान्तं महाबाहुं प्रत्यगृह्णात् तवात्मजः॥ शरैश्चावाकिरद् राजशैनेयं तनयस्तव।
en: Beholding hinthus advance your son received him. Indeed, O king, your son then poured upon him a veritable shower of arrows.

sa: युध्यन्तः सर्वराजानस्तेजस्तिग्ममुपासते। सिन्धुराजं परित्रातुं स वो मध्ये कथं हतः॥
en: How was it that the king of Sindhu was slain in their midst, since for the purpose of rescuing him all the kings fought with fiery energy.

sa: हंसा ऊचुः वयं हंसाश्चरामेमां पृथिवीं मानसौकसः। पक्षिणां च वयं नित्यं दूरपातेन पूजिताः॥
en: The Swans said "We are swans and live in the Manasa lake. We range over the whole earth and amongst the winged creatures we are always spoken high for the length of the distances we traverse.

sa: अपश्यन् सात्यकिं चापि वृष्णीनां प्रवरं रथम्। चिन्तयाभिपरिताङ्गो धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: Without finding also that foremost of the Vrishnis namely Satyaki, that great car-warrior, king Yudhishthira the virtuous became overwhelmed with anxious thought and his limbs became weak.

sa: महाधनैराभरणैश्च दिव्यैः शस्त्रैश्च दीप्तैरपि सम्पतद्भिः। रथे रथे पञ्च विदीपकास्तु प्रदीपकास्तत्र गजे त्रयश्च॥
en: The precious ornaments (wom by the combatants) and of the blazing celestial weapons that were hurled (by the Kaurava army against their enemies). Five lamps were placed on each car and three on each maddened elephants.

sa: यथा श्वेतो महानागो देवराजचमूं तथा। नागो मणिमयो राज्ञो ध्वजः कनकसंवृतः॥
en: Like the prodigious white elephant adorning the host of the ruler of the celestials. On the gold-decked standard of king Duryodhana, was the device of an elephant embossed with gems.

sa: प्रविश्य विचरन्तं च रथे शूरमवस्थितम्। कथं द्रोणं महेष्वासं पाण्डवाः पर्यवारयन्।॥
en: How did the Pandavas oppose that mighty bowman, the heroic Drona, who having entered it (i.e., the hostile army) was moving about (the field of battle) stationed on his car.

sa: तं यमौ पृष्ठतोऽन्वैतां रक्षन्तौ पुरुषर्षभौ। द्रोणायाभिमुखं यान्तं दीप्यमानमिवानलम्॥
en: The twins, Nakula and Sahadeva, those two foremost of men, then protected Dhristadyumna from behind as he rushed upon Drona like a blazing fire.

sa: तं नागमिव सिंहेन दृष्ट्वा राजशरादितम्। जवेनाभ्यद्रवञ्छूराः पञ्च पाण्डवतो रथाः॥
en: Then fierce heroic warriors of the Pandava army rushed quickly to the rescue of an Dhristadyumna, who then resembled elephant assailed and afflicted by an enraged lion.

sa: एवमेवात्मनो वीर्यमहं वीर्यं च पाण्डवे। जाननेवाह्वये युद्धे शल्य गाण्डीवधारिणम्॥
en: Knowing my own strength as well as that of Pandava I have challenged him in battle, O Shalya, I shall not fall into fire like an insect.

sa: वध्यमानो महाबाहुः सुतपुत्रेण पाण्डवः। न विव्यथे भीमसेनो भिद्यमान इवाचलः॥
en: The mighty-armed son of Pandu viz., Bhimasena, though thus pierced by the son of Suta, felt no pain, like a mountain having no sensation when cleft open.

sa: अक्रोशन्त ततः सर्वे धार्तराष्ट्राः सराजकाः॥ गृह्णीध्वमिति राजानमभ्यधावन्त सर्वशः।
en: Then all the soldiers of your army with their king sent up a loud war-cry saying-"seize him" and then they rushed towards the king.

sa: ततो विस्फार्य सुमहद्धेमपृष्ठं दुरासदम्। चापं भरतशार्दूलस्त्यक्तात्मा कर्णमभ्ययात्॥
en: Them, o foremost of the Bharatas, stretching his invincible and gold-decked bow, Bhima rushed at Krishna, reckless of his very life.

sa: ततः पाञ्चालशैनेयौ द्रौपदेयाः प्रभद्रकाः। शिखण्डी च महानागान् सिषिचुः शरवृष्टिभिः॥२७
en: Thereupon the chief of the Panchalas, the grandson of Shini, the son of Draupadi, the Provodrakas and Shikhandin, poured forth showers of arrows upon those huge elephants.

sa: दासी जितासि द्यूते त्वं यथाकामचरी भव। वाससां वाहिका राज्ञो भ्रातुर्येष्ठस्य मे भव॥
en: "You are our slave; you have been won by us as a stake in the game of dice; become you a courtezan; and engaged yourself as a bearer of attires to the king, my elder brother.

sa: तत्राक्रन्दो महानासीत् पञ्चालानां महारणे॥ वध्यतां सायकैस्तीक्ष्णैः कर्णचापवरच्युतैः।
en: Afflicted with the sharp shots coming out of Karna's bow in that battle the Panchalas sent forth bitter cries of woe.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच अजितो द्रोणराधेयविकर्णकृतवर्मभिः। तीर्णः सैन्यार्णवं वीरः प्रतिश्रुत्य युधिष्ठिरे॥
en: Dhritarashtra said Having promised to Yudhishthira to do so, the heroic Satyaki crossed the ocean of my troops, unvanquished cven by Drona, Radha's son, Vikarna and Kritavarman.

sa: न चैवास्मात् प्रमोक्षध्वं घोरात् पापानराधमाः। तस्मात् तेषां भागहरा भागिनेया न सूनवः॥
en: You villains, you will never escape the consequences of this great iniquity. It is for this O Shalya, that the sisters sons of the Arattas become their heirs and not their own sons,

sa: ततः सुबलपुत्रस्य नागानतिबलान् पुनः। पोथयामास कौन्तेयो द्विपञ्चाशदरिंदमः॥
en: Then the son of Kunti, the subduer of foes, struck down fiftytwo highly powerful elephants belonging to the son of Subala.

sa: ऋषयः सिद्धसंघाश्च व्यतिष्ठनत दिदृक्षया। तदप्सरोभिकीर्णं यक्षगन्धर्वसंकुलम्॥
en: And sages and hosts of Siddhas, were seen on all sides. Thronged with Apsaras and Yakshasas and Rakshasas.

sa: द्रुपदं वृषसेनस्तु ससैन्यं सपदानुगम्। वारयामास समरे द्रोणप्रेप्सुं महारथम्॥
en: In that engagement Vrishasena resisted the highly puissant Drupada, (who) accompanied by his troops and retainers, (advanced forward) with the desire of slaying Drona.

sa: ताशरान् द्रोणमुक्तांस्तु शरवर्षेण पाण्डवः अवारयत धर्मात्मा दर्शयन् पाणिलाघवम्॥
en: Then that son of Pandu, of virtuous soul, with his own showers of arrows checked those discharged by Drona, displaying great lightness of hands.

sa: कृष्णाश्रयाः कृष्णबलाः कृष्णनाथाश्च पाण्डवाः। कृष्णः परायणं चैषां ज्योतिषामिव चन्द्रमाः॥
en: The Pandavas have Krishna for their shelter, Krishna for their strength and Krishna for their leader. Krishna is their main support like the moon of the constellations.

sa: उग्राश्च भीमकर्माणस्तुषारा यवनाः खशाः। दाभिसारा दरदाः शका माठरतङ्गणाः॥ आन्ध्रकाश्च पुलिन्दाश्च किराताश्चोग्रविक्रमाः। म्लेच्छाश्च पर्वतीयाश्च सागरानूपवासिनः॥ संरम्भिणो युद्धशौण्डा बलिनो दण्डपाणयः। एते सुयोधनस्यार्थे संरब्धाः कुरुभिः सह॥ न शक्या युधि निर्जेतुं त्वदन्येन परंतप।
en: The Tusharas, the Yavanas, the Khashas, the Darbabhisaras, the Daradas, the Shakas, the Ramathas, the Tanganas, the Andhraks, the Pulindas, all of fierce temperament and awful deeds and the Kiratas of formidable prowess and the Mlechhas, the mountain tribes and the people inhabiting the sea coasts, all of whom are very powerful unflinching in battle and wielders of maces, have gathered round the standard of the Kurus and been fighting hard for Suyodhana. And none else but you, O scorcher of foes, could defeat them in battle.

sa: स कर्णचापप्रभवानिषूनाशीविषोपमान्। बिभ्रद्र भीमो महाराज न जगाम व्यथां रणे॥
en: Bhima then with the body struck with the arrows discharged from Karna's bow, that resembled snakes of virulent poison did indeed feel no pain, O mighty monarch.

sa: अथ कृष्णो महाबाहुरर्जुनं प्रत्यभाषत। पश्य वृष्ण्यन्धकव्यानं सौमदत्तिवशं गतम्॥
en: Thereupon the mighty-armed Krishna addressing Arjuna, said. “Behold the foremost of the Vrishni and Andhaka races, viz., Satyaki succumb to the son of Somadatta.

sa: सहस्ररश्मिप्रतिमं ज्वलन्तं दिशश्च सर्वाः प्रतपन्तमुग्रम॥ तमोनुदं मेघ इवातिमात्रं धनंजयं छादयिष्यामि बाणैः।
en: He burns down his enemies like the sun of fiery rays and shines in his fame. As the clouds gather round the dispeller of darkness, so I shall cover Dhananjaya with my shafts,

sa: सरथः सध्वजस्तत्र ससूतः पाण्डवस्तदा। प्राच्छाद्यत महाराज कर्णचापच्युतैः शरैः॥
en: O mighty monarch, the son of Pandu with his car, standard and charioteer, was covered all over with the arrows shot from Karna's bow.

sa: तं हतं यज्ञसेनस्य पुत्रेणेह शिखण्डिना। पाण्डवेयाभिगुप्तेन श्रुत्वा मे व्यथितं मनः॥
en: He (that mighty hero) was killed in the battle by the son of Yajnasena (namely) Shikhandin, who who was protected by the Pandavas. At this (occurrence) my heart greatly aches.

sa: तस्य मे सारथिः शल्यो भवत्वसुकरः परैः। नाराचान् गार्धपत्रांश्च शकटानि वहन्तु मे॥
en: Let Shalya, therefore, who is irresistible by the antagonists, act as my charioteer. And let the carts also convey my long shafts, as well as the arrows furnished with the feathers of vultures.

sa: लेलिहानं यथा सर्प गर्जन्तमृषभ यथा। वनस्थितं यथा व्याघ्र जहि कर्ण धनंजयम्॥
en: Dhananjaya is looking like a snake protruding his quivering tongue, or like a bull bellowing loudly in rage, or indeed, like a tiger of a forest; O Karna, put an end to him.

sa: विनिवार्य स वीराणामस्त्रैरस्त्राणि सर्वतः। दर्शयन् रौद्रमात्मानमुने कर्मणि धिष्ठितः॥ स तान् रथवरान् राजन्नत्याक्रामत् तदार्जुनः। मोहयन्निव नाराचैर्जयद्रथवधेप्सया।
en: Repulsing everywhere the weapons of heroes with those of his own and displaying his fierce feats, Arjuna then continued to a achieve terrible deeds. Then impelled by the desire for killing Jayadratha, O king, Arjuna passed through the car-division, compounding your warriors with his Narachas.

sa: ऋते महारथात् कर्ण कुन्तीपुत्राद् धनंजयात्। स हि तेषामतियशा देवानामिव वासवः॥
en: Except the mighty car-warrior Partha, that son of Kunti who had conquered the lord of wealth himself. Like Vasava among the Gods, he is the most illustrious among the Pandavas.

sa: एवं विद्वञ्जोषमास्स्व त्रासात् किं बहु भाषसे॥ मा त्वा हत्वा प्रदास्यामि क्रव्याद्भयो मद्रकाधम।
en: Do not speak more. Knowing this Why do you rove in such a way from fear? O wretch of a Madraka, I shall not kill you now and offer your dead body to the carnivorous animals,

sa: जनमेजयो गदायोधी पर्वतीयः प्रतापवान्॥ दुर्मुखेन महाराज तव पुत्रेण पातितः।
en: O great monarch, that great wielder of mace, Janamejaya, the dweller of the hilly country, who was possessed of great energy, was slain by your son Durmukha.

sa: अहमेव तु राधेयं मोहयामि युधां वर। ततो नावासृजच्छक्तिं पाण्डवे श्वेतवाहने॥
en: O foremost of warriors, it was I who confounded the son of Radha, in consequence whereof he did not hurl that Satki at the son of Pandu owning white steeds.

sa: अथ कृष्णौ महाभागौ तावका वीक्ष्य दंशितौ। अभ्यद्रवन्त संक्रुद्धास्तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्॥
en: Then your warriors beholding the two Krishnas cased in mair became excited with rage; and they rushed upon them both. All this looked wonderful.

sa: शल्यश्च दशभिर्बाणैत्रिभिर्दुःशासनस्तथा। दुर्योधनस्तु विंशत्या शकुनिश्चापि पञ्चभिः॥
en: Drona's son pierced Dhristadyumna with five, Drona himself with five, Shalya with nine and Dushasana with three Vallas.

sa: सर्वेषां तत्र भूतानां लोमहर्षोऽभ्य तद् दृष्ट्वा समरे कर्म कर्णशैनेययोर्नृप।॥
en: Hairs on the body of all creatures present there stood erect on beholding in that battle the wonderful feats of Karna and of the grandson of Sini.

sa: ते म्लेच्छः प्रेषिता नागा नरानश्वान् स्थानपि। हस्तैराक्षिप्य ममृदुः पश्चिाप्यतिमन्यवः॥
en: Being driven by the Mlechchas, these elephants, highly enraged, had cast down the men, the horses and cars, with their trunks and crushed them with their feet.

sa: तथैव सिंहलाङ्गलं द्रोणपुत्रस्य भारत॥ ध्वजाग्रं समपश्याम गलसूर्यसमप्रभम्।
en: We beheld the standard-top of Drona's son, resembling the tail of the lion and effulgent like the newly-risen sun, O Bharata.

sa: कार्मुके योजयित्वा तं दुपदं संनिरीक्ष्य च। आकर्णपूर्ण मुमुचे त्रासयन् सर्वसोमकान्॥
en: And adjusting it to the string and aiming at Drupada and drawing (his bow-string) up to the very ear, discharged it, striking terror into (the hearts of all the Somakas.

sa: जलसंधं महाबाहुं भीमसेनोऽभ्यवर्तत। युधिष्ठिरः सहानीकः कृतवर्माणमाहवे॥
en: Bhimasena rushed against the mighty armed Jalasandha and king Yudhishthira supported by his divisions assailed Kritavarman in battle.

sa: राजा भगीरथो वृद्धो बृहत्क्षत्रश्च केकयः। पराक्रमन्तौ विक्रान्तौ निहतौ वीर्यवत्तरौ॥
en: Both the old king Bhagiratha and Brihatkshatra, the chief of the Kekayas, highly powerful, possessed of prowess and greater energy as they were, also killed in battle.

sa: ततोऽधिरूढे वरदे प्रयाते चासुरान् प्रति। साधु साध्विति विश्वेशः स्मयमानोऽभ्यभाषत॥
en: Thereupon when the boon-giving Lord, after mounting upon the car, was advancing towards the Asuras, the Lord of the universe smilingly addressed him saying-"Most excellent! Most excellent!"

sa: शोणितादिग्धवाजाग्राः सप्त हेमपरिष्कृताः। पुत्राणां तव राजेन्द्र पीत्वा शोणितमुद्गताः॥
en: Those seven arrows of the effulgence of molten gold, steeped in blood, came out, O king after having drank the life-blood of your sons.

sa: अथापरे पुनः शूराश्चेदिपश्चालकेकयाः। कारूषाः कोसलाः काच्या मागधाश्चपि दुद्रुवः॥
en: Thereupon the other heroic leaders, namely the Chedis, the Panchalas, the Kaikeyas, the Karushas, the Kosalas, the Kanchyas and the Magadhas advanced most rapidly.

sa: आदीप्तमिव तत् सैन्यं शरैश्छिन्नतनुच्छदम्। आसीत् सुशोणितक्किनं फुल्लाशोकवनं यथा॥
en: Resembling a forest of blooming Asoka the troops, streaming with blood, with their armours broken, looked red as if they were ablaze with fire.

sa: सिंहेनेव मृगं ग्रस्तं नरसिंहेन मारिष। द्रोणेन मोचयामास पाञ्चाल्यं शिनिपुङ्गवः॥
en: Thus, 0 sire, Satyaki rescued Dhrishtadyumna, who had been seized by that foremost of the preceptor, that best of men, like a deer seized by a lion.

sa: कचित् संग्रामो विदतौ वै तवायं समागमे सृञ्जयकौरवाणाम्। यत्रावस्थामीदृशी प्रापितोऽहं कञ्चित् त्वया सोऽद्य हतो दुरात्मा॥
en: You do full well remember how hotly the battle raged when the Srinjayas and the Kaurava's faced each other-the encounter in which I was brought to such a sad plight. Did you come face to face with Karna and shoot him down?

sa: ते तत्त्वं सर्वमाख्याय शिरोभिः सम्प्रणम्य च। वधोपायमपृच्छन्त भगवन्तं पितामहम्॥
en: They then, having described who whole history and also having bowed down to him with their heads, asked the lord grandsire the fitting means of their destruction.

sa: तमेव पुदुतं संख्ये धृष्टद्युम्नो महारथः। अनुप्रयाति संग्रामे हतान् पश्य चसृञ्जयान्॥
en: The great chariot holder (Maharathi) Dhrishtadyumna is pursuing Ashvatthama who himself is also marching forward in battlefield. Look there! A number of Srinjaya warriors have been killed in the war.

sa: स तु शोकसमाविष्टो विमुखः पुत्रवत्सलः॥ शाश्वतं धर्ममुत्सृज्य गुरुः शस्त्रेण घातितः।
en: It was then that his disciple, transgressing all morality, slew his preceptor, filled with do you you with affection for his son and unwilling to fight and possessed by grief.

sa: कलिङ्गानां तु तं शूरं क्रुद्धं क्रुद्धो वृकोदरः। रथाद् रथमभिद्रुत्य मुष्टिनाभिजघान ह॥
en: Vrikodara, then fired with rage, leaped from (his own) car to that of the heroic prince of a : Kalinga, who also was (very) angry and killed him with blows from his fists.

sa: छित्त्वा शक्तिं ततो भीमो निर्मुक्तोरगसंनिभाम्। मार्गमाण इव प्राणान् सूतपुत्रस्य मारिष॥
en: Cutting off that lance resembling a snake just freed from its slough, Bhima, O sire, as if looking out for the opportunity of wrenching the life-breaths out of Suta's son.

sa: तदस्य लाघवं दृष्ट्वा प्रहस्य द्विजपुङ्गवः। प्रेषयामास विशिखानष्टौ संनतपर्वणः॥
en: Then seeing his lightness of hands, that foremost of the regenerate ones smiled and once more, sped at him eight shafts of depressed knots.

sa: सत्यसेनस्तु संक्रुद्धस्तोमरं व्यसृजन्महत्। समुद्दिश्य रणे कृष्णं सिंहनादं ननाद च॥
en: Then Satyasena, indeed, being greatly enraged, directed his large lance, aiming at Krishna, in the battle; and sent fort a loud roar like that of a lion.

sa: नकुलं कुशलं युद्धे पराक्रान्तं पराक्रमी। अभ्यगच्छत् समायान्तं विकर्णस्ते सुतः
en: O master, your son Vikarna endued with great might assailed Nakula, endued with strength and versed in the art of fighting, who had been proceeding to fight.

sa: विक्रोशमाने हि मयि भृशमाचार्यगृद्धिनि। अपाकीर्य स्वयं धर्मं शिष्येण निहतो गुरुः॥
en: Setting at naught all dictates of morality, the pupil has slaughtered his preceptor, although I exclaimed at the top of my voice, protesting that the preceptor should not be slain.

sa: तथा सुतस्ते ज्वलनार्कवर्णं रथं समास्थाय कुरुप्रवीरः। व्यवस्थितः पुरुमित्रो नरेन्द्र व्यभ्रे सूर्यो भ्राजमानो यथा खे॥
en: O lord of men, riding on a car resembling the Sun or the fire in splendour, similarly your son, Purumitra, that best hero amongst the Kurus, is careering on the field, even as the Sun, shining brightly wanders on the cloudless firmament.

sa: कैकेयोऽस्रं समालोक्य मुक्तं द्रोणेन संयुगे। ब्रह्मास्त्रेणैव राजेन्द्र ब्राह्ममस्रमशातयत्॥
en: Beholding that weapon discharged by Drona in battle, the Kekaya prince, O foremost of kings, cut down that weapon with his own Brahma weapon.

sa: तां वृष्टिं सहसा राजन्नुत्थितां घोररूपिणीम्। वारयामास शैनेयो योधयंस्तान् महारथान्॥
en: Then fighting, O king, (fearlessly) on with those warriors, that scion of Shini's race checked that awful shower of pouring arrows which had been begun so suddenly.

sa: ब्रह्मास्रमुद्यतं दृष्ट्वा कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः। ब्रह्मास्रेणैव राजेन्द्र तदत्रं प्रत्यवारयत्॥
en: Seeing that the Brahma weapon was uplifted, Yudhishthira, the son of Kunti, baffled that weapon by means of Brahma weapon, O king of kings.

sa: स भीमं पञ्चभिर्विद्ध्वा पुनर्विव्याध सप्तभिः। विशोकं त्रिभिरानछेद् ध्वजमेकेन पत्रिणा॥
en: Having (first) pierced Bhima with five shafts and then again with seven, be struck Vishoka (Bhima's chariotcer) with three darts and his (i.e. Bhima's) standard with one.

sa: ततः प्रमुच्य कौन्तेयं द्रोणो दुपदवाहिनीम्। व्यधमत् क्रोधताम्राक्षो वायव्यास्रेण भारत॥
en: Leaving the son of Kunti, Drona, then, whose eyes became as red as copper in rage, began to destroy, by means of weapons, the army of Drupada.

sa: यादृशं कृतवानद्य त्वमेकः शत्रुतापनः। एवमेव हते कर्णे सानुबन्धे दुरात्मनि॥
en: As you have singly shown this day. O tormentor of foes, when the wicked-souled Karna together with his followers shall be vanquished (by you) I will thus.

sa: परलोकगतस्यापि भविष्याम्यनृणः पितुः। आर्येण हि न वक्तव्या कदाचित् स्तुतिरात्मनः॥
en: I may be free from the debt I still owe to my sire who has proceeded to Heaven. A noble person never indulges in his own praise;

sa: पितुर्वधममृष्यंस्तु वक्ष्यामोह पौरुषम्। अद्य पश्यन्तु मे वीर्यं पाण्डवाः सजनार्दनाः॥
en: But incapable of tolerating the slaughter of my sire, I shall today untter my own praises-Let the Pandavas with Janardana at their head today behold my prowess.

sa: प्राच्याश्च दाक्षिणात्याच प्रवरा गजयोधिनः। अङ्ग वङ्गाश्च पुण्ड्राश्च मागधास्ताम्रलिप्तकाः॥
en: Many foremost of clephant-warriors belonging to the tribes called the Easterners, the Southerners, the Angas, the Bangas, the Pundras, the Magadhas and the Tamaliptakas.

sa: जातरूपमयीश्चर्टीः पट्टिशान् हेमभूषणान्। दण्डैः कनकचित्रैश्च विप्रविद्धान् परश्वधान्॥
en: These Rishtis made of gold, Pattisha trimmed by gold and the axes with gold studded handles all thrown on the ground.

sa: भ्रान्तमुद्भान्तमाविद्धमाप्लुतं प्रसृतं सृतम्। परिवृत्तं निवृत्तं च खङ्गं चर्म च धारयन्॥ सम्पातं समुदीर्णं च दर्शयामास पार्षतः। भारतं कौशिकं चैव सात्वतं चैव शिक्षया॥ दर्शयन् व्यचरद् युद्धे द्रोणस्यान्तचिकीर्षया। चरतस्तस्य तान् मार्गान् विचित्रान् खड्गचर्मिणः॥
en: Armed with his sword and his buckler in grasp the son of Prisata, wheeled about, whirled his sword in the air, made side thrusts, rushed forward, ran sideways, jumped up, assailed the sides of his foes, fell backwards, ran into close quarters with his enemy and pressed them hard. having practised them well he also exhibited the movements, known as Bharata, Kousika and Satvata, as he coursed in battle for bringing about Drona's death. Beholding those charming movements of Dhristadyumna, as he coursed, armed with shield and sword in battle.

sa: निश्चेष्टास्तुं ततो योधानबधीत् पाण्डुनन्दनः। यथेन्द्रः समरे दैत्यांस्तारकस्य वधे पुरा॥
en: Then the son of Pandu began to slay all those inactive warriors as Indra killed the Asuras in the days of yore in his encounter with Taraka.

sa: तस्य संचरतो राजन् मण्डलावर्तने तदा। क्षुरप्रेण सुतीक्ष्णेन खङ्गं चिच्छेद सुप्रभम्॥
en: O monarch, he (Shakuni) severed the sword, that was most excellent, of his foe, who then was careering in circles in the field, by means of his sharp razor-headed arrows.

sa: तस्य रूपं बभौ राजन् भारद्वाजं जिघांसतः। यथा रूपं पुरा विष्णोर्हिरण्यकशिपोर्वधे॥
en: Solicitous of slaying the son of Bharadvaja, O king, his appearance then resembled that of Hari when, in days of yore, he was going to slay the Daitya king Hiranyakasipu.

sa: यतस्तामेव जग्राह प्रहसन् पाण्डुनन्दनः। कर्णायैव च दुर्धर्षश्चिक्षेपाजौ वृकोदरः॥
en: But the son of Pandu seized that (dart) with a smile. And in that encounter the invincible Vrikodara hurled that very dart of Karna.

sa: पुनः स्वरथमास्थाय दुद्राव तव वाहिनीम्। तमायान्तं जिघांसन्तं भीमं क्रुद्धमिवान्तकम्॥
en: Returned to his own car and (then) rushed against your troops. When Bhima desirous of staying (your troops), was (thus) advancing furiously like the (grim) destroyer himself.

sa: सोऽतिष्ठद् युगमध्ये वै युगसन्नहनेषु च। जघनार्धेषु चाश्वानां तत् सैन्याः समपूजयन्॥
en: Sometimes he stood on the yoke of Drona's car and sometimes under the haunch's of his red steeds. These motions of his were then greatly praised by all the troops.

sa: तौ दृष्ट्वा मातुलस्तत्र विरथौ परवीरहा। अभ्यभाषत राधेयं मद्रराजोऽनुकम्पया॥
en: Seeing them deprived of their cars, their maternal uncle, the king of Madra and slayer of inimical heroes, out of compassion said to Karna.

sa: असंशयं तथाभूतः पाञ्चाल्य: साध्वमन्यत। वधमाचार्यमुख्यस्य प्राप्तकालं महात्मनः॥
en: Undoubtedly, under these circumstances, the Panchala prince resolved to make an end of that foremost of preceptor, that most illustrious warrior.

sa: प्रत्यक्षं ते महाबाहो यथा रात्रौ घटोत्कचः॥ मायाशतानि कुर्वाणो हतो मायापुरस्कृतः।
en: O mighty-armed heroes, you have witnessed it with your own Ghatotkacha, who dreamed innumerable dreams, was slain by (Karna) in that night with several other illusions before him. eyes and

sa: एवमुक्तः प्रत्युवाच नकुलं सूतनन्दनः। सदृशं राजपुत्रस्य धन्विनश्च विशेषतः॥
en: Being thus addressed, the son of Suta replied to Nakula in expressions worthy of the son of a king and of a bowman specialiy.

sa: विविंशतिर्महाराज राजपुत्रो महाबलः। आनर्तयोधाशतशो निहत्य निहतो रणे।॥
en: O great king, having killed hundreds of Anarta warriors, the royal son Vivinshati of mighty strength was himself slain in battle.

sa: स च्छिन्नधन्वा पाञ्चाल्यो निकृत्तध्वजसारथिः। उत्तमामापदं प्राप्य गदां वीरः परामृशतः॥
en: With his bow cut-off, his car rendered useless, his elephants and driver slain and thus involved in a perilous situation that hero began to whirl his mace.

sa: निवृत्तैश्च पुनः पार्थेर्भग्नं शत्रुबलं महत्। कौरवान् द्रवतो ह्येष कर्णो रोधयतेऽर्जुन॥
en: O Arjuna! See there, the Pandava warriors have loosened the steps of the huge army of enemies. This This Karna is preventing the Kauravas' warriors departing away from the battle-field.

sa: यतो राजा जयद्रथ.i श्रूयते पुण्डरीकाक्ष त्रिषु धर्मेषु वर्तते॥ प्रतिज्ञा सफलां चापि कर्तुमर्हसि मेऽनघ।
en: O Krishna, urge the steeds to the top of their speed, so that they may soon carry me to spot where king Jayadratha is, O sinless one, it behoves you, to help me in the fulfilment of my vow!

sa: श्रृणु दुन्दुर्भिनिर्घोषं शङ्खशब्दं च दारुणम्॥ सिंहनादांश्च विविधाश्रेणु पाण्डव सर्वतः।
en: to Hear, O son of Pandu, the noise of their tumtums and the shrill note of their conchs and lion-like roars that are coming from all directions.

sa: संजय उवाच प्रादुर्भूते ततस्तस्मिन्नने नारायणे प्रभो। प्रावात् सपृषतो वायुरनभ्रे स्तनयित्नुमान्॥
en: Sanjaya said When that Narayana weapon had been invoked into existence, the wind began to blow from opposite directions and peals of thunder were heard though the sky was cloudless.

sa: अलम्बुषो भृशं क्रुद्धो घटोत्कचमताडयत्। तयोर्युद्धं समभवद् रक्षोग्रामणिमुख्ययोः॥
en: Highly excited, Alambusha began to strike Ghatotkacha. The battle between those two best and foremost of the Rakshasas that then raged.

sa: तमसा चावकीर्यन्त सूर्यश्च कलुषोऽभवत्। सम्पतन्ति च भूतानि क्रव्यादानि प्रहृष्टवत्॥
en: The veil of darkness spread over the earth.। The sun became dimmed in splendour. Diverse। kinds of flesh-eating animals began to alight on the field of battle.

sa: सैन्धवस्य वधेनैव भृशं दुःखसमन्वितः। मर्तव्यमिति संचिन्त्य प्राविशच द्विपद्वलम्॥
en: Afflicted with great sorrow at the destruction of the king of Sindhu and determined to sacrifice his life, he entered into the enemy's army.

sa: अभिषिक्तस्तु राधेयः प्रभया सोऽमितप्रभः। अत्यरिच्यत रूपेण दिवाकर इवापरः॥
en: Having been thus installed in the generalship, the son of Radha of unparalleled radiance surpassed all the beauty and splendour like a second Sun.

sa: ततः शरसहस्रेण तावुभौ पुरुर्षभौ। अन्योन्यमाच्छादयतामथोऽभज्यत वाहिनी॥
en: Those two foremost of men covered each other with thousands of arrows at which their respective battalions broke.

sa: ततो बाणमयं वर्षं द्रोणपुत्रस्य मूर्धनि। अवासृजदमेयात्मा पाञ्चाल्यो रथिनां वरः॥
en: Then that foremost of car-warriors, that prince of the Panchalas, of unmeasurable depth of soul, poured a veritable shower of arrows on the head of Drona's son.

sa: अवधेन वधः प्रोक्तो यद् गुरुस्त्वमिति प्रभुः। तद् ब्रूहि त्वं यन्मयोक्तं धर्मराजस्य धर्मवित्॥
en: To address a venerable superior as 'You.' is to kill him without actually depriving him of his life. Therefore do you, who are versed in morality, address Yudhishthira the righteous, in the manner I have indicated.

sa: श्रुत्वा स निनदं भीमं तावकानां महाहवे। शैनेयस्त्वरितो राजन् कृतवर्माणमभ्ययात्॥
en: That hero viz., the grandson of Sini, hearing that fierce uproar of your army in that dreadful battle, quickly, O monarch, turned back and advanced against Kritavarman.

sa: प्रत्युद्ययुस्त्रिगर्तास्तं शिबयः कौरवैः सह। शाल्वः संशप्तकाश्चैव नारायणबलं च तत्॥
en: The Trigartas, the Shibis along with the Kaurava force, the Shalyas, the army of the Samsaptakas and the force called the Narayana, all proceeded against him (Arjuna).

sa: ततोऽपरे तत्प्रतिमा गजोत्तमा जिगीषवः संयति सव्यसाचिना। तथा कृतास्ते च यथैव तौ द्विपौ ततः प्रभग्नं सुमहद्रिपोर्बलम्॥
en: Thereafter several other foremost of elephants, resembling the above-mentioned ones, that were most desirous of gaining victory, were slain by Savyasachin, even as the two elephants (belonging to Dandadhara) had been slaughtered smitten already. Afterwards the vast army on the side of the enemies dispersed.

sa: ते तमभ्यर्दयन् बाणैरूल्काभिरिव कुञ्जरम्॥ अततेष्वसनाः शूरा नृत्यन्त इव भारत।
en: O Bharata, they with drawn bows distressed Arjuna with fiery arrows even as do the hunters an elephant and seemed to dance in the battlefield (With excitement).

sa: ततः प्रहष्टो दाशार्हः पाण्डवश्च धनंजयः। व्यक्रोशेतां महानादं दध्यतुश्चाम्बुजोत्तमौ॥
en: Thereupon he of the Dasharha race and Dhananjaya the son of Pandu filled with delight, uttered loud shouts and blew their best of conchs.

sa: स कथं सात्यकिं शिष्यं सुखसम्बन्धमेव च॥ अस्मदर्थे च युध्यन्तं त्यक्त्वा प्राणान् सुदुस्त्यजान्।
en: men Why then should I not protect, Satyaki my disciple and my dear relative who is fighting in this battle on our behave reckless of the very life that is so difficult of being laid down?

sa: विविधा विशिखास्तत्र सम्पतन्तः परस्परम्॥ फलैः पुत्रान् समाजग्मुः सूतपुत्रधनुच्युताः।
en: Various sorts of arrows fell there touching one another. Those, shot off the bow of Karna, touched the wings of others with their blades.

sa: अभिप्रायं तु कृष्णस्य ज्ञात्वा परपुरंजयः। आजिशीर्षगतं पार्थं भीमसेनोऽभ्युवाच ह॥
en: Then seeing through the purposes of Krishna, that subduer of hostile cities viz., Bhimasena, addressing Arjuna then stationed at the van of the troop, said these words.

sa: हाहाकारो महानासीत् सैन्यानां भरतर्षभ। तदुद्यम्य महाबाहुः सात्यकिं न्यहनद् भुवि॥
en: Loud cried of Oh and Alas arose among the troops, foremost of the Bharatas, as the mighty-armed (Bhurisravas) striking vigorously had brought Satyaki down on the earth.

sa: बाणजालावृत्ते व्योम्नि च्छादिते च दिवाकरे। न स्म सम्पतते भूम्यां किंचिदप्यन्तरिक्षगम्॥
en: When the firmament was thus closed with the net-work of arrows and the sun was covered over with them, none of the rovers of the sky descended upon the earth.

sa: वार्यमाणौ ततस्तौ हि शैनेयशरवृष्टिभिः। शैनेयस्य रथं तूर्णं छादयामासतुः शरैः॥
en: Thereupon those two brothers, whose progress was checked by the shower of arrows of Sini's grandson, indeed, covered the car of Sini's grandson with lots of shafts.

sa: उवाच तद्गौरिति यद् ब्रुवाणो हृष्टो वदेः कर्णसुयोधनाभ्याम्। ये राजसूयावभृथे पवित्रा जाताः कचा याज्ञसेन्या दुरात्मन्॥ स्तद् ब्रूहि त्वां पृच्छन्ति भीमसेनः।
en: He said O Duratmana (notorious), remember the day when you had addressed me as "Bull" under grip of ecstasy in company of Karna and Duryodhana. Tell me the hand by which you had dragged Draupadi with a grip on her hair when she had just taken bath (Avabhritha Snana)? This Bhimasena enquires and expects reply from you.

sa: यौ तौ समीयतुर्वीरौ वैकर्तनवृकोदरौ। कथं तावत्र युध्येतां महाबलपराक्रमौ॥
en: How did those two mighty car-warriors Karna and Vrikodara fight with each other, in that combat that raged in the neighborhood of Partha's chariot?

sa: आरुह्य भगवान देवो दीप्यमानः स्वतेजसा।।७८ अभीषून हि प्रतोदं च संजग्राह पितामहः।
en: Having mounted upon that car, the illustrious Grandsire, that God who blazed forth with the splendour of his own, then indeed took up the reins of the horses, as well as the goad.

sa: प्राच्यां दिशि सहस्रांशोररुणेनारुणीकृतम्। तपनीयं यथा चक्रं भ्राजते रविमण्डलम्॥
en: The eastern quarter was soon rendered crimson by the myriad rays of the sun and the solar disc looked like a circle of gold.

sa: ततो बाणैरावृणोदन्तरिक्षं दिव्यां मायां योधयन् राक्षसस्य। ह्रीमान् कुर्वन् दुष्करं चार्यकर्म नैवामुह्यत् संयुगे सूतपुत्रः॥
en: Then Karna covered the welkin with his shafts, striking agair..t that celestial illusion of the Rakshasas. The son of Suta, endowed with modesty and achieving the most difficult and praiseworthy feats, was not at all confounded in that battle.

sa: अद्य शोणितसम्मग्नं शयानं पतितं भुवि॥ अपविद्धायुधं कर्ण दीनाः पश्यन्तु बान्धवाः।
en: Let his relations with distress witness today the (sad) spectacle of Karna's falling prostrate and lying down on the bosom of the Earth, weltered in blood and bereft of arms.

sa: सा पुरस्ताच पश्चाच गृहीता भारती चमूः। तत्र कृत्यमहं मन्ये सैन्धवस्याभिरक्षणम्॥
en: The Bharata army have simultaneously been attacked both from the van and the rear. At this crisis, I consider our foremost duty is to protect the ruler of the Sindhus,

sa: कर्णोऽपि समरे राजन् विधूमोऽग्निरिव ज्वलन्॥ दहंस्तस्थौ महाबाहुः पाण्डवानां महाचमूम्।
en: In that battle, the mighty and strong-armed Karna, O king, burning the vast army of the Panchalas, stood out in relief like a blazing fire without smoke.

sa: उपास्त्वद्भुजनिर्मुक्ता मर्म भित्वा महाशराः॥ अद्य कर्णं महावेगा: प्रेषयन्तु यमक्षयम्।
en: Let the sharp and winged arrow of irresistible force shot by your arms touch Karna to the core and dispatch him off to the den of Pluto.

sa: स संनिपातस्तुमुलो घोररूपो विशाम्पते॥ आसीद् रौद्रो महाराज कर्णपाण्डवयोर्मधे।
en: The encounter, O king, that once more took place between Karna and Bhima, was highly dreadful and fierce and accompanied by a loud noise.

sa: इत्युक्तवानधर्मज्ञस्तदा परमदुर्मतिः॥ पापः पापवचः कर्णः शृण्वतस्त्व भारत।
en: O Bharata, these vile words were uttered by that sinful, debased, mischievous and unprincipled Karna at that time, in your hearing.

sa: भागोऽवशिष्टः कर्णस्य तव चैव महाद्युते। तं भागं सह कर्णेन युगपन्नाशयाद्य हि॥
en: O most resplendent one, the rest of the share given to Karna as well as to yourself still remains. Being accompanied by Karna, do you at once proceed to the field of battle.

sa: तत उत्थाप्य भगवास्तान् हयाननिलोपमान्॥ बभाषे च तदा स्थाणुमारोहेति सुरोत्तमः।
en: Thereupon that illustrious God, after having hitted those horses, that resembled the wind in swiftness, they addressed the foremost of the celestials Sthanu saying “Do you ascend.”

sa: व्यक्तं षण्ढतिला ह्येते निरये च निमज्जितः॥ प्रेष्यवचापि राजानमुपस्थास्यन्ति कौरवम्।
en: Verily these (men) are like sesame seeds without kernel and have fallen into purgatory and they will have to serve ere long that foremost of Kaurava Kings.

sa: सर्वे चास्य महीपाला योगक्षेममुपासते। पश्येदानीं यथा भद्रे विनष्टाः पाण्डवाः समम्॥ अन्योन्यं समुदीक्षन्ते धार्तराष्ट्रस्य तेजसा।
en: Today all the other lords are engaged in helping him towards the good government of his state. Lo, O amiable one, how all the Pandavas have equally fallen, under the prowess of Dhirtarasthtra's son and have now been staring at each other.

sa: द्रोणपुत्रस्तु शिरसि ग्रीवायां सर्वसोदरा। मध्ये दुर्योधनो राजा बलेन महता वृतः॥
