en: The son of Drona was stationed in the head; and all the uterine brothers were in the neck. King Duryodhana was stationed in the middle, surrounded by a large force.

sa: विमुञ्चञ्छरवर्षाणि पर्जन्य इव वृष्टिमान्। छादयामास शैनयं जलदो भास्करं यथा॥
en: Discharging a shower of arrows as the clouds (pour down) torrents of rain, he (i.e., Somadatta) covered the grandson of Sini like the clouds (covering the sun)

sa: ततः सरथनागाश्वाः कुरवाः कुरुसत्तमम्। निर्भया भरतश्रेष्ठमभ्यवर्तन्त फाल्गुनम्॥
en: Then many Kauravas with their horses, elephants and cars boldly faced that foremnost man of Kuru and Bharata races viz. Phalguni.

sa: राधेयं निर्जितं दृष्ट्वा तावका भरतर्षभ।॥ धनंजयशरैर्नुन्नाः प्राद्रवन्त दिशो दश।
en: 0 best of the Bharatas, witnessing the defeat of the son of Radha, your Partisans, (already) mangled by the shafts of Dhananjaya ran away in ten directions.

sa: धृष्टधुम्नस्ततो राजशनकैरब्रवीद् वचः॥ मुह्यते मे मनस्तात गात्रस्वेदश्च जायते। वेपथुश्च शरीरे मे रोमहर्षश्च सारथे॥
en: Thereupon, O monarch, Dhristadyumna slowly said these words-'O sire, my mind is being stupefied; and there is perspiration in my limbs. I feel a sensation of trembling in my body; and also the hairs and standing erect upon it.

sa: सहित: सर्वयोधैस्त्वं व्यूढानीकैः सुरक्षितः। धनंजयेन युध्यस्व श्रेयश्चेत् प्राप्तुमिच्छसि॥
en: If you wish to secure your well-being, fight with Dhananjaya from the division of your own army well protected and aided by your warriors.

sa: विषमं च समं चैव हतैरश्वपदातिभिः॥ रथैश्च कुञ्चरैश्चैव न प्राज्ञायत किञ्चन।
en: The earth became so covered over with dead bodies of horses, foot soldiers, elephants and with broken cars that it became impossible to distinguish the even land from the uneven.

sa: सूर्याचन्द्रमसौ यद्वत् तद्वदर्जुनकेशवौ। प्राकाश्वेनाभिविख्यातौ त्वं तु खद्योतवन्नृषु॥
en: Like the sun and the moon Kesava and Arjuna are famous for their effulgence; you are but a fire-fly among men.

sa: यथा च सर्वथाऽऽपत्सु वार्ष्णेयः पाति पाण्डवम्। तथा मद्रेश्वराद्य त्वं राधेयं प्रतिपालय॥
en: Even as that descendant of the Vrishni race protects the son of Pandu all means in all his difficulties, so, O chief of the Madras, do you support today the son of Radha.

sa: स हत्वा राक्षसानीकं रराज द्रौणिराहवे। युगान्ते सर्वभूतानि संवर्तक इवानलः॥
en: The son of Drona, while (thus burning that Rakshasa host in battle shone like the Samvartaka fire (consuming) all the creatures at the end of a Yuga.

sa: अथ तान् द्विरदान् सर्वान नानालिङ्गैः शरोत्तमैः। सपताकध्वजारोहान् गिरीन् वज्रेरिवाहनत्॥
en: As the mountain is broken to pieces by thunder, so those elephants, with their riders and their standards were knocked down by various choice shafts (from Arjuna).

sa: दैवं प्रमाणं सर्वस्य सुकृतस्येतरस्य वा। अनन्यकर्म दैवं हि जागर्ति स्वपतामपि॥
en: It is fate that always bears testimony to our acts, whether good or evil. Fate which is (ever) bent on its purpose is wide awake even when everything else sleeps.

sa: जिघांसुर्भरतश्रेष्ठ विव्याध निशितैः शरैः। दशभिः सात्यकि विदध्वा सौमदत्तिरथापरान्॥
en: O foremost of the Bharatas, desirous of slaying the former, pierced him with sharp arrows. Having pierced Satyaki then with ten arrows, Somadatta's son.

sa: ऋते हि त्वां महाभाग वासुदेवसमं युधि। स पाहि सर्वथा कर्णं यथा ब्रह्मा महेश्वरम्॥
en: Indeed, O greatly fortunate one, these exists on one, who can restrain the horses belonging to Karna, excepting yourself, who are cruel to Vasudeva in battle. So do you protect Karna by all means, even as Brahma protects Maheshvara.

sa: न चेदद्य हि तं वीरं निहनिष्यसि संयुगे। प्राणानेव परित्यक्ष्ये जीवितार्थो हि को मम॥
en: If you do not overcome that indomitable hero in today's battle, then surely I will give up my life, what would be the use of bearing the burden of this body and carrying it on the earth any longer?

sa: पश्य कर्ण रणे श्वेतच्छत्रविराजितम्। उदयं पर्वतं यद्वच्छसाङ्केनाभिशोभितम्॥
en: See Partha, Karna is shining in the battlefield with a white umbrella like the Udaya (rising mountain) beautified with the moon.

sa: हत्वा दशसहस्राणि पार्थिवानां महारथः। संशप्तकानां कौन्तेयः प्रत्यक्षं त्वरितोऽभ्ययात्॥
en: Having killed ten thousand of the chiefs, that great car-warrior the son of Kunti proceeded rapidly to the further end of the Samasaptakas array.

sa: यदि नारायणास्रस्य प्रतियोद्धा न विद्यते। अद्यैतत् प्रतियोत्स्यामि पश्यत्सु कुरुपाण्डुषु॥
en: If there is none who can venture to contend against the Narayana weapon, let then the Kurus and the Pandavas behold how I shall quell that weapon.

sa: संशप्तकानां च बले पाण्डवेन महात्मना। धनंजयेन विक्रम्य गमिते यमसादनम्॥
en: The army of the Samsaptakas was sent away to the region of Yama by Dhananjaya, the lofty-minded son of Pandu, through the exertion of his terrible prowess.

sa: शल्य उवाच अजय्यमेनं प्रवदन्तिन युद्धे महारथाः कर्ण रथप्रवीरम्। एकाकिनं किमु कृष्णाभिगुप्तं विजेतुमेनं क इहोत्सहेत॥
en: Shalya said O Karna, this (Arjuna) the best of warriors even when alone, is considered to be unconquerable by all the warriors and now when he is protected by Krishna it is really a venture to try to face and defeat him.

sa: क्षत्रिस्य मलं भक्ष्यं ब्राह्मणस्याश्रुतं मलम्। मलं पृथिव्यां वाहीकाः स्त्रीणां मद्रस्त्रियो मलम्॥२३
en: Begging is a Kshatriya's dirt, the nonobservance of vows is that of Brahmana. The Vahikas are the dirt of the earth and the Madra women are the dirt of the whole female sex.

sa: अश्वपृष्ठेषु चाप्यन्ये रथनीडेषु चापरे। गजस्कन्धगताश्चान्ये शेरते चापरे क्षितौ॥
en: Some laid themselves down on the back of horses, some on the elephants, some on the carterraces and some on the bare earth only.

sa: श्रीवासुदेव उवाच जरासंघश्चेदिराजो नैषादिश्व महाबलः। यदि स्युर्न हताः पूर्वमिदानीं स्युर्भयंकराः॥
en: Vasudeva said Had not Jarasandha, the ruler of the Chedis and the highly puissant prince of the Nishadas been slain before, they would have become very terrible by this time.

sa: तथा रक्षः पिशाचाच हिमवन्तं नगोत्तमम्। गुह्यकाश्च महाराज पर्वतं गन्धमादनम्॥
en: The Rakshasas and Pichashas protect Himavat, the best of mountains. The Guhykas protect, O great king, the mount Gandhamadana. Forsooth does Vishnu otherwise called Janardana all creatures.

sa: स तु तं प्रतिविव्याध पञ्चभिर्निशितैः शरैः॥ रुक्मपुखैर्महेष्वासो गापत्रैरजिह्मगैः।
en: Him the fierce bowmen Satyaki pierced in return with five sharp shafts, all straight flying and furnished with golden as well as vulterine wings.

sa: तामापतन्तीं दृष्टैव गदां रोहिणिनन्दनः। प्रतिघातार्थमस्रं वै स्थूणाकर्णमवासृजत्॥
en: Then beholding that mace course towards us, the son of Rohini, for repulsing that mace, hurled the weapon know as Sthanukarna.

sa: तथैव कृष्णं नवभिः समादयत् पुनश्च पार्थं दशाभिर्जधान्। रभ्याहतः श्वेतहयः शरैस्तैः॥
en: Arjuna, the rider on white horses filled with slight anger as he was also injured by the arrows shot by Vrishasena. He then decided to kill the son of Karna.

sa: शाकलं नाम नगरमापगा नाम निम्नगा। जर्त्तिका नाम वाहीकास्तेषां वृत्तं सुनिन्दतम्॥
en: There is a town of the name of Shakala, a river by the name of Apaga and a clan of the Balhikas known as Jarttikas. Their conduct is very reprehensible.

sa: अथान्यद् धनुरादाय सात्यकिः सत्यविक्रमः। बिव्याध बहुभिर्वीरं भारद्वाजं शिलाशितैः॥
en: Thereafter Satyaki of prowess incapable of being baffled taking up another bow, pierced the heroic son of Bharadvaja with numerous shafts whetted on stone.

sa: स पपात ततो वाहात् सुलोहितपरिस्त्रवः। मनःशिलागिरेः शृङ्गं वज्रेणोवावदारितम्॥
en: His like extinguished, the body bathed in blood fell down from his car like the summit of Manashila mountain clapped down by a thunder-bolt.

sa: तान् वारय महाबाहो केकयांश्च नरोत्तम। पुरा कुर्वन्ति निःशेषं रक्ष्यमाणाः किरीटिना॥
en: O mighty-armed and most excellent of men, check the career of these and also of the Kaikayas, before, they, backed up as they are by Kiriti, destroy (all our forces).

sa: दध्मौ शङ्ख महाबाहुरर्जुनश्च परंतपः॥ भीमश्च वृष्णिसिंहश्च युधामन्युश्च भारत।
en: Blew his conch, as also the mighty Arjuna that afflicter of his foes. Bhimasema also, as if for informing Yudhishthira of that joyful news.

sa: अमितौजा युधामन्युरुत्तमौजाश्च वीर्यवान्॥ निहत्य शतशः शूरानस्मदीयैर्निपातिताः।
en: Having slaughtered hundreds of heroes, Amitaujah, Yudhamanyu and Uttamanjah endued with prowess, were all slain by our followers.

sa: तत्रार्जुनो नरव्याघ्रः शरैर्मुक्तैः सहस्रशः॥ अदृश्यांस्तावकान् योधान् प्रचक्रे शत्रुतापनः।
en: That foremost of men, that scorcher of his foes, viz., Arjuna discharging his arrows by thousands, made all the soldiers of your army invisible.

sa: स चाप्यशक्यः संग्रामे जेतुं सर्वसुरासुरैः। वधार्थं तस्य जातोऽहमन्येषां च सुरद्विषाम्॥
en: He also was incapable of being conquered in battle by the celestials and the Asuras. I suffered this birth only for slaughtering him and other such molesters of the gods.

sa: कार्णायसतनुत्राणान् नरानश्वांश्च पाण्डवः। पोथयामास गदया सशब्दं तेऽपतन हताः॥
en: The son of Pandu knocked down horses and men with black armour on, by his mace; they all came crumbling down with great noise.

sa: ते वध्यमाना समरे सूतपुत्रेण सृञ्जयाः। तमेवाभिमुखं यान्ति पतङ्गा इव पावकम्॥
en: The Srinjayas were slaughtered by the son of Suta in the field of battle and they rushed towards the force of Karna, even as the insects rash towards the fire.

sa: गुरुं ते यत्र पाञ्चाल्य: केशपक्षे परामृशत्॥ तन्न जातु क्षमेद् द्रौणिर्जानन् पौरुषमात्मनः।
en: The Panchala prince dragged my poor preceptor by the locks of his hair. Certainly Drona's son will not forgive that act of his, aware as he is of his own manliness and resources.

sa: प्रसाद्य भक्त्या राजानं प्रीते चैव युधिष्ठिर। प्रयावस्त्वरितौ योद्धं सूतपुत्ररथं प्रति॥
en: Let us pacify king Yudhishthira with due obeisance and when he is reconciled let both of us march against the chariot of the son of Suta and fight him out.es

sa: महान् व्यतिकरो रौद्रो योधामान्वपद्यत। कर्णसायकनुन्नानां युध्यतां च शितैः शरैः॥
en: The most dreadful and distressing calamity had fallen upon all the warriors while they were fighting with the keen arrows and cut-off with the shafts of Karna.

sa: इदं तु मे यथा प्राज्ञं शृणु वाक्यं विशाम्पते। अनिहत्य रणे पार्थं नाहमेष्यामि भारत॥
en: O ruler of earth, do you listen to my speech, uttered in accordance with my wisdom. O descendant of the Bharata race, if I cannot slay the son of Pritha in battle, I will not return from the field.

sa: द्रोणः पञ्चदिनान्युमो विधम्य रिपुवाहिनीम्॥ कृत्वा व्यूहमभेद्यं च पातयित्वा महारथान्। जयद्रथस्य समरे कृत्वा रक्षां महारथः॥ अन्तकप्रतिमश्चोग्रो रात्रियुद्धेऽदहत् प्रजाः।
en: The violent Drona having arranged his troops in an impenetrable array has slain the army of the enemies and many a mighty charioteer for five days together. That valiant charioteer having protected Jayadratha in battle committed a havoc amongst the hostile army during the nocturnal fight, like the fierce Destroyer himself.

sa: रुदित्वा सुचिरं कालं भ्रातरौ सुमहाद्युती। कृतशौचौ महाराज प्रीतिमन्तौ बभूवतुः॥
en: Having thus indulged themselves for some time and assuaged their grief the two brothers of bright effulgence became reconciled to each other and were once again cheerful.

sa: कुरवो हि महाराज निर्विषाः पन्नगा इष। कर्णमेवोपलीयन्त भयाद् गाण्डीवधन्वनः॥
en: O monarch, the Kauravas, all afraid of the holder of the Gandiva, like snakes whose stock of venom has exhausted, looked up to Karna for their safety.

sa: युध्यमानं द्वात्रिंशत्करणानि स्युर्यानि युद्धानि भारत। तान्यदर्शयतां तत्र युध्यमानौ महाबलौ॥
en: Then those two puissant combatant's displayed in that encounter all the thirty kinds of manoeuvres and acts that are the principal feathers of these kinds of encounters.

sa: सारथिस्तमपोवाह स्मरन् सारथिचेष्टितम्। तस्मिन् प्रभग्ने राजेन्द्र पञ्चालानां महारथे॥
en: Remembering the duty of (all) charioteers, his driver bore him away. O lord of kings, that great car-warrior among the Panchalas being (thus) defeated.

sa: हाहाकृतानि भूतानि पाण्डवाश्च विशेषतः। भीमसेनमपश्यन्त तेजसा संवृतं तथा॥
en: All creatures cried Oh and Alas and specially the Pandavas did so, at the sight of Bhimasena wrapt in the effulgence of that weapons.

sa: धनुश्च्युताः शरास्तस्य शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः। आकाशे प्रत्यदृश्यन्त शलभानामिवायतीः॥
en: Arrows shot from his bow then, in hundreds and thousands, were seen to range through the welkin, like flights of locusts.

sa: परिश्रान्तं युधां श्रेष्ठं सम्प्राप्तो भूरिदक्षिणः। युद्धाकाङ्क्षी समायान्तं नैतत् सममिवार्जुन॥
en: Bhurisravas who has made great sacrificial presents, rushing upon that foremost of warriors viz., Satyaki exhausted with fatigue, has no encountered him. This is indeed very unfair."

sa: निमेषमात्रेण च तज्जयोतिरन्तरधीयत। आसीत् किलकिलाशब्दः प्रहृष्टानां दिवौकसाम्॥
en: But within an wink of time however, that light disappeared and then tumultuous noise of the delighted celestials were heard there,

sa: रणे चरत्येष रथप्रवीरः सितैर्हयैः कौरवराजपुक्षः। स वाद्य मां नेष्यति कृच्छमेतत् कर्णस्यान्तादेतन्तास्तु सर्वे॥
en: Perhaps this son of the Kuru king (Arjuna), who is being borne by white steeds will send me this day to my last account, but there will be an end of all these with my fall.

sa: भ्रमन्त इव शूरस्य शरव्राता महात्मनः॥ अदृश्यन्तान्तरिक्षस्थाः शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः।
en: Then hundreds and thousands of shafts shot by the heroic Arjuna of illustrious soul, appeared in the sky, flying in all directions and incessantly.

sa: कृत्ताग्रहस्तैः करिभिः कृत्तदन्तैर्मदोत्कटैः। हयैश्च विधुरग्रीवै रथैश्च शकलीकृतैः॥
en: With infuriate elephants having trunks and tusks severed and broken respectively, with horses deprived of riders and necks; with shattered chariots.

sa: पुरुजित् कुन्ति भोजश्च मातुलौ सव्यसाचिनः॥ संग्रामनिर्जिताँल्लोकान् गमितौ द्रोणसायकैः।
en: Purujit and Kuntibhoja, the two maternal uncles of Savyasachin, were sent by the shafts of Drona to those regions that are attainable in battle.

sa: तस्य चापच्युतैर्बाणैः परदेहविदारणैः॥ पूर्णामाकाशमभवद् रुक्मपुङ्खैरजिह्मगैः।
en: The atmosphere became thick with goldfeathered, straight-shot deadly arrows, that were discharged from his bow.

sa: शिखण्डिनं याज्ञसेनि रुन्धानमपराजितम्। बाह्रीकः प्रतिसंयत्तः पराक्रान्तमवारयत्॥
en: Exerting his best, Balhika resisted the invincible and puissant Sikhandin the son of Yajnasena, capable resisting all foes.

sa: आतुरो हि कृतो राजा संनिषेव्यश्च भारत। यथैनमनुवर्तन्ते पञ्चालाः सह पाण्डवैः॥ त्वरमाणास्त्वराकाले सर्वशस्त्रभृता वराः। मज्जन्तमिव पाताले बलिनोऽप्युजिहीर्षवः॥
en: Forsooth, O Arjuna, the king is greatly wounded and weakened, since the Panchalas, the wielders of all sorts of weapons, accompanied with Pandavas, are following him hurriedly at a time when it is necessary to display speed like unto men rushing to rescue a man sinking under earth.

sa: उभौ कलिङ्गवृषको भ्रातरौ युद्धदुर्मदौ। कृत्वा चासुकरं कर्म गतौ वैवस्वतक्षयम्॥
en: Having achieved the extraordinary exploits in battle, both the brothers, Kalinga and Vrishabha, who are incapable of being vanquished in battle, departed to the abode of Death.

sa: अदृष्टपूर्वं पश्यामि शिलानामिव सर्पणम्। त्वया सम्प्रेषिताः पार्थ नार्थं कुर्वन्ति पत्रिणः॥
en: O Partha, now I see a sight never before seen by me, which is as wonderful as the moving about of hills. Winged shafts shot by yourself, are becoming abortive!

sa: ततः सम्भूय विबूधास्तान् हन्तुं कृतनिश्चयाः। चक्रुः शत्रुवधे यत्नं न शेकुर्जेतुमेव तान्॥
en: Thereupon all the celestials, having united together, were determined upon to slaughter them; and also made attempts to bring about the destruction of these antagonists. But they, however, were incapable of vanquishing them.

sa: तास्तु विद्रवतो दृष्ट्वा निरुत्साहन द्विषजये। द्रावयन्निषुभिस्तीक्ष्णैः श्रुतवर्मा व्यरोचत॥
en: Having seen them flying away (from the battle) hopeless of conquering the enemies, Srutakarman, pursuing and shooting keen arrows upon them, looked most brilliant.

sa: अद्य दुःशमहं मोक्ष्ये त्रयोदशसमार्जितम्॥ हत्वा कर्णं रणे कृष्ण शम्बरं मघवानिव।
en: And like Maghavat causing the slaughter of Shambara, I will O Krishna, killing Karna, today in battle, shake off the heavy affliction I have been cherishing these thirteen long years.

sa: तैस्तस्य निशितैस्तीक्ष्णैर्भीमसेनो महाबलः। चिच्छेद परवीरघ्नः प्रहसन्निव भारत॥ ध्वजं शरासनं चैव शरावापं च भारत। कर्णोऽप्यन्यद् धनुर्गृह्य हेमपृष्ठं दुरासदम्॥ ततः पुनस्तु राधेयो हयानस्य रथेषुभिः। ऋक्षवर्णाञ्जघानाशु तथोभौ पाणिसारथी॥
en: And his standard and bow and his leathern fence, O Bharata. The mighty Bhimasena, that slayer of hostile heroes, with the greatest heedfulness, cut-off with those sharp arrows, O Bharata, the standard, the bow and the leathern fence of Karna's chariot. Thereupon the son of Radha, grasping another tough and golddecked bow, sped a large number of shafts and therewith quickly dispatched Bhima's steed of the hue of bear and then his two flank protector.

sa: यत् तु पार्थेन मां दृष्ट्वा प्रतिज्ञामभिरक्षता। सखङ्गोऽस्य हृतो बाहुरेतेनैवास्मि वञ्चितः॥
en: Partha by lopping off the arm of this one, with sword in grasp, had fulfiled his vow of protecting his own partisans and has thereby robbed me of my glory!

sa: मन्यध्वं मृत इत्येवमेतद् वो बुद्धिलाघवम्। युक्तो ह्यस्य प्रतीघातः कृतो मे कुरुपुङ्गचाः॥
en: Yet you had taken me as already slain. It is indeed a great foolishness on your part. You foremost of the Kurus, the slaughter of Bhurisravas achieved by me, in indeed very proper.

sa: स मे वध्यो भवेच्छत्रुर्यद्यपि स्यान्मुनिव्रतः। चेष्टमानं प्रतीघाते सभुजं भां सचक्षुषः॥
en: Would be slain by me even though that antagonist of mine should adopt the vow of asceticism. Though I was fighting in battle with my arins and cyes in tact.

sa: व्यालीव मन्त्राभिहता कर्णबाणैरभिद्रुता। तस्याः प्रतिनिपातेन भीमस्य विपुलो ध्वजः॥
en: Being repulsed by the arrows of Karna, like a snake charmed with incantations. At the rebound of that mace the mighty standard of Bhima.

sa: ये वै षण्ढतिलास्तत्र भवितारोऽद्य ते तिला:। हते वैकर्तने कर्णे सूतपुत्रे दुरात्मनि॥
en: After the fall of the son of Suta the vicioussouled Karna, also called Vaikartan, those words that were at one time sesame seeds without grain, will turn out today to be the reverse.

sa: आ मत्स्येभ्यः कुरुपञ्चालदेश्या आ नैमिषाचेदयो ये विशिष्टाः। धर्म पुराणमुपजीवन्ति सन्तो मद्रादृते पाञ्चनदांश्च जिह्यान्॥
en: The Matsyas, the Kurus, the Panchalas, the Naimishas and all other respectable races know the eternal truths of religion. This cannot be said of the Madrakas and the wily people that live in the land of the five rivers.

sa: विकत्थमानः शौर्येण सर्वलोकधनुर्धरम्। दर्पोत्सेधगृहीतोऽद्य न कश्चिद् गणयन् मृधे॥
en: Without reckoning any of the words of bowmen in battle, puffed up with pride as you are, you are boasting today of your manliness.

sa: इति मामब्रवीत् सूत मन्दो दुर्योधनः पुरा। वसुषेणसहायं मां नालं देवाऽपि संयुगे॥
en: O Suta, This did my wretched son Duryodhana speak to me before. “Supported as I am by the heroic Vrisashena, even the celestials themselves will not be able to conquer me in battle.

sa: ताञ्छरान् समरे राजन् वेगेनापततो बहून्। एकैकं पञ्चभिर्बाणैः सहदेवो न्यकृन्तत॥
en: Then Shahadeva, O monarch, cut-off every one of these innumerable arrows, that were falling with speed (upon him) with five shafts of his own in that battle.

sa: स हन्यमानः समरे कृतास्त्रेण बलीयसा॥ प्राद्रवत् सहसा राजन् नकुलो व्याकुलेन्द्रियः।
en: O monarch, Nakula of agitated senses, who was struck by that most powerful warrior, well versed in the science of arms in the battle, fled away all on a sudden.

sa: भीमस्य निघ्नतः शत्रून् पाणिं जग्राह पाण्डवः। द्रोणोऽपि पाण्डुपञ्चालान् व्यधमद् रजनीमुखे॥
en: The son of Pandu, took up his station at the flank of Bhima who was destroying the foes. Drona also began, at that nigiit, to destroy his enemies, the Panchalas.

sa: कामः सम्पद्यतामस्य बीभत्सोराशु मा प्रति। कल्याणवृत्तिराचार्यो मया युधि निपातितः॥
en: Let king Duryodhana today attain the fruition of his desires for I have slain the prcccptor who used to treat us so mercifully and like a friend.

sa: यदि चैतत् कथञ्जित् स्यालोकपर्यासनं भवेत्। हन्यां कर्णं तथा शल्यं बाहुभ्यामेव संयुगे॥
en: But if it so happens you must know that revolution of the word is near and as for myself I will send both Shalya and Kama to the Pluto's den with my army:

sa: स भवान् धुर्यवत् संख्ये धुरमुद्वोढुमहति। अभिषेचय सैनान्ये स्वयमात्मानमात्मना॥
en: You should, like the commander of the force, bear all the burden in battle. So, should you be installed as the general by yourself.

sa: प्रतिरुद्धस्ततः कर्णो रोषात् प्रस्फुरिताधरः। शिखण्डिनं त्रिभिर्बाणैभ्रुवोर्मध्येऽभ्यताडयत्॥
en: Thus obstructed and with his lips trembling in anger Karna struck Shikhandi on the forehead with three arrows.

sa: प्रणयाद् बहुमानाश्च तं निगृह्य सुतस्तव। अब्रवीन्मधुरं वाक्यं साम्ना सर्वार्थसाधकम्॥
en: Then your son, having received him (Shalya) with great affection and high respect, addressed him in a friendly manner these sweet expressions, pregnant with very grave ideas.

sa: ततो दुर्योधनो राजा धर्मशीलस्य मारिष। शिलाशितेन भल्लेन धनुश्चिच्छेद संयुगे॥
en: Thereupon, O sire, the king Duryodhana severed the bow of that righteous one (Yudhishthira) by means of a broad-headed arrows, sharpened on a stone, in the battle.

sa: युगपत् पेततुरि घोरौ परिघमार्गणौ॥ शरीरे सोमदत्तस्य स पपात महारथः।
en: Both the formidable Parigha and the arrow, having at one and the same time, fallen upon the body of the heroic Somadatta, that mighty car-warrior fell down.

sa: एष राजसहस्राणां वक्त्रैः पङ्कजसंनिभैः। आस्तीर्य वसुधां पार्थ क्षिप्रमायाति सात्यकिः॥
en: O son of Pritha, here comes Satyaki in all quickness, having covered the earth with the heads of thousand's of kings, graced with faces resembling blooming lotuses.

sa: विचित्रविविधकारैः शरीरावरणैरपि। विचित्रैश्च रथैर्भग्नैर्हतैश्च गजवाजिभिः॥
en: With wonderful cuirasses of different shapes, with charming chariots shattered, with slain horses and elephants.

sa: विसृष्टः पाण्डवो राजन् सूतपुत्रेण धन्विना। ब्रीडन्निव जगामाथ युधिष्ठिररथं प्रति॥
en: O king, the son of Pandu, being thus abandoned by that bowman, the son of Suta and feeling shame for it, went towards the car of Yudhishthira.

sa: ततोऽस्यनिशितैर्वाणैस्त्रिभिर्विव्याध सारथिम्। तान् सर्वान् सहिताशूरान् यतमानान् महारथान्॥
en: Next he pierced the latter's charioteer with three sharp arrows. Then all those mighty carwarriors who were fighting unitedly and heedfully.

sa: यत् स्यादहिंसासंयुक्तं च धर्म इति निश्चयः। अहिंसाय भूतानां धर्मप्रवचनं कृतम्॥
en: All that is free from any motive of injury to any being is surely morality. For, indeed, the moral precepts have been made to free the creatures from all injuries.

sa: आपतन्तं महावेगं धृष्टद्युम्नसमीरितम्। शरैश्चिच्छेद पुत्रस्ते त्रिभिरेव विशाम्पते॥
en: O king, with three arrows your son cut-off the shaft discharged by Dhristadyumna which was about to fall with great force.

sa: नैवाद्राक्षं न चाश्रौषं तव कश्मलमीदृशम्। पुरातिदुःखदीर्णानां भवान् गतिरभूद्धि नः॥
en: “Never before did I seen you afflicted with such great grief. In days gone by, you were our only comforter when we were afflicted with extreme distress.

sa: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे राजन् दृष्ट्वा कर्णस्य विक्रमम्। आकर्णमुक्तैरिषुभिः कर्णस्य चतुरो हयान्॥ अनयत् प्रेतलोकाय चतुर्भिः श्वेतवाहनः। सारथिं चास्य भल्लेन रथनीडादपातयत्॥
en: In the meantime, o king, beholding the prowess of Karna, Arjuna of white horses, with four shafts shot from the bow-string drawn back to the ear, dispatched the four horses of Karna to the regions of Death. Then with a bhalla he felled Karna's charioteer from his niche in the car.

sa: अथ दृष्ट्वा व्यतिक्रान्तौ ज्वलिताविव पावकौ। निराशाः सिन्धुराजस्य जीवितं न शशंसिरे॥
en: Beholding them beyond those divisions and look like two blazing fires, your troops became despondent and they gave up all hopes for the life of the ruler of the Sindhus.

sa: अस्त्रयुद्धे ततो राजन् वर्तमाने महाभये। अपश्याम रणे द्रौणि व्यात्ताननमिवान्तकम्॥
en: Then, O king, a great encounter of weapons took place in that great battle when we saw the son of Drona like Death himself with widening mouth.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा पलायन्ते सर्वे भारत पार्थिवाः। विसंज्ञा वाहयन् वाहान् न च द्वौ सह धावतः॥
en: 0 Bharata, saying this, all the kings deprived, (as it were) of their senses and urging the animals (on which they rode), fled away (from the field) and no two then (so great was their terror) did run together.

sa: ततः शब्दो महानासीद् युयुधानरथं प्रति। आकीर्यमाणा धावन्ती तव पुत्रस्य वाहिनी॥
en: Then a mighty uproar was heard nec. the car of Yuyudhana. Your son's troops, then covered with the shafts of Satyaki, began to run away from the field of battle.

sa: राजा द्रोणाय चोत्सृष्टः सैन्धवश्चानिपातितः। प्रत्युद्याति च शैनेयमेष भूरिश्रवा रणे॥
en: The king has been left to the mercy of Drona; the ruler of the Sindhus is still unslain and yonder does Bhurisravas rush against Satyaki in battle.

sa: छादयामास स शरैस्तव पुत्रस्य पश्यतः। संछाद्यमानः समरे हताश्वो हतसारथिः॥
en: Then he covered Karna himself with a network of arrows, even before the very eyes of your son. Thus covered with arrows, the steedless and driverless Karna.

sa: ततस्तेऽप्याययुर्हत्वा राक्षसान् यत्र सूतजः। नकुलः सहदेवश्च सात्यकिश्च महारथः॥
en: Then those warriors, viz., Nakula, Sahadeva and the mighty car-warrior, Satyaki, also came to the spot where Suta's son was, having slain many Rakshasas.

sa: कृतं तं विरथं वीरं क्षत्रधर्मे व्यवस्थितम्॥ दौःशासनिर्महाराज सौभद्रं हतवान् रणे।
en: O powerful monarch, the son of Dushasana, after having dispossessed the son of Subhadra of his car, who was still observing the duties of a Kshatriya slew him in battle.

sa: मया त्वं समनुज्ञातः कृष्णेन च महात्मना। गच्छ पुण्यकृताल्लोकाञ्छिबिरौशीनरो यथा॥
en: With my permission as also with that of the high-souled Krishna do you go to the regions of the righteous where Sivi the son of Usinara is.

sa: त्वद्बुद्धिबलवीर्येण कृतवानेष फाल्गुनः। बाल्यात् प्रभृति ते कृष्ण कर्माणि श्रुतवानहम्॥
en: Have, O Krishna, obtained immortality and are in enjoyment of eternal regions. O destroyer of foes, it is by means of the prowess obtained through your favour.

sa: शिखण्डिनं तु समरे भीष्ममृत्यु दुरासदम्॥ हार्दिक्यो वारयामास स्मयन्निव मुहुर्मुहुः।
en: The son of Hridika, smiling over and over again, resisted Shikhandin, who was the cause of death of Bhishma and most invincible in the field of battle.

sa: कर्णोऽपि रथिनां श्रेष्ठश्चापमुद्यम्य वीर्यवान्। कौरवाग्रयैः परिवृतः शक्रो देवगणैरिव॥ पर्यतिष्ठत तेजस्वी स्वबाहुबलमाश्रितः। ततः प्रववृते युद्धं कर्णस्य सह पाण्डवैः॥
en: The puissant and energetic Karna too taking up his bow and surrounding by the foremost of the Kauravas, like Shakra by the celestials, awaited (their charge) relying on the strength of his own arms. The battle, that then took place between Karna (on one side) and the Pandavas (on the other).

sa: सोऽतिविद्धो महाबाहुः सृक्विणी परिसंलिहन्। युधिष्ठिरस्य चिच्छेद ध्वजं कार्मुकमेव च॥
en: That mighty bowman, being (thus) deeply pierced, for a moment licked the corners of his mouth and (then) cut-off the standard and also the bow of Yudhishthira.

sa: एतत् पार्थस्य तु वचस्ततः श्रुत्वा महाद्युतिः। यूपकेतुर्महाराज तूष्णीमासीदवाङ्मुखः॥
en: Then the stake-bannered Bhurisravas of great effulgence O king having heard those words of Partha, become silent with his face turned towards the earth.

sa: तद् रुक्मपृष्ठं भीमस्य धनुर्घोरं महारणे। विकृष्यमाणं विबभौ शक्रचापमिवापरम्॥
en: Then the mighty and formidable bow of Bhima, of golden staff stretched continuously in that battle appeared beautiful like another bow of Indra (rainbow).

sa: यत्रास्मि भरतश्रेष्ठ योग्यः कर्मणि कर्हिचित्। तत्र सर्वात्मना युक्तो वक्ष्ये कार्यं परंतप॥
en: O foremost of the Bharata race, for whatever acts I am competent, there I will engage myself with the whole of my heart; and I will bear the burden of all your acts.

sa: व्रात्यानां दासमीयानां कृतेऽप्यशुभकर्मणाम्। ब्रह्मणा निन्दिते धर्मे स त्वं लोके किमब्रवीः॥
en: When even in the golden age the Brahman had consumed those fallen men of evil deeds who were begotten by Sudra on others' wives who can put them to shame?

sa: तत्राद्भुतं पुनश्चक्रे राधेयः शत्रुकर्शनः॥ यदेनं पाण्डवाः सर्वे न शेकुरभिवीक्षितुम्।
en: The son of Radha, that scorcher of his enemies, displayed once again such wonderful prowess that the Pandavas, all combined, dared not even to look at him.

sa: द्रोणस्य विहिता राजन् यैधृष्टद्युम्नमाक्षिणोत्। स वध्यमानो बहुभिः सायकैस्तैर्महाबलः॥
en: Where known to Drona only and by means of them, he succeeded in weakening Dhristadyumna's powers. Then the puissant Dhristadyumna wounded with those arrows,

sa: संजय उवाच तौ शङ्खभेरीनिनदे समृद्धे समीयतुः श्वेतहतौ नराग्रयौ। वैकर्तनः सूतपुत्रोऽर्जुनश्च दुर्मत्रिते तव पुत्रस्य राजन्॥
en: Sanjaya said When the blare of conchs and sound of bugles became very high in the battle-field, those two, Suta's son Vaikartana and Arjuna mounted on white horses, closed each other, O king, on account of the vile policy of your son.

sa: अतस्त्वमेतेन सरोषमुक्तो दुःखाचितेनेदमयुक्तरूपम्। अकोपितो ह्येष यदि स्म संख्ये कर्णं न हन्यादिति चाब्रवीत् सः॥
en: Heavy at heart as he was at all this, he used such angry and improper expressions to you. Moreover, he addressed you in that tenor thinking that if he could provoke you, you would forthwith slay Karna in battle.

sa: शक्तिं विनिहतां दृष्ट्वा पुत्रस्तव विशाम्पते॥ नवभिर्निशितैर्भल्लैर्निजघान युधिष्ठिरम्।
en: O ruler of earth, your son, beholding that Shakti-arrow thus severed into pieces, struck Yudhishthira with nine whetted and sharppointed arrows.

sa: विमुञ्चन् विशिखांस्तीक्ष्णानाचार्ये भृशमार्दयत्। महामेघो यथा वर्ष विमुञ्चन् गन्धमादने॥
en: Discharging sharp arrows incessantly, he afflicted the preceptor sorely, like a mighty cloud afflicting the mountain Gandhamadana by pouring its watery contents on it.

sa: मया हिमवतः शृङ्गमेकेनाध्युषितं चिरम्। दृष्टांश्च बहवो देशा नानाधर्मसमावृताः॥
en: I lived for a long time alone on a summit of the Himalaya mountain, since then I have seen various countries following various religions.

sa: विगाह्य तु स्थानीकमश्वसंघांश्च फाल्गुनः॥ व्यचरत् पृतनामध्ये पाशहस्त इवान्तकः।
en: Penetrating into the midst of those cars and horses drawn in array Phalguna move about like the destroyer himself armed with his fatal noose.

sa: एष दत्तवरः शेते प्रमाथी राक्षसेश्वरः। तव हेतोविशालाक्षि निहतो रावणो मया॥
en: Do you behold, O you having expansive eyes, Rāvaņa, the lord of Rākşasas, the repressor of people and who obtained a boon, lying there, slain by me on your account.

sa: निर्भिद्य बाणैस्तपनीयवर्णैः। ववर्ष राम शरवृष्टिजालैः सलक्ष्मणं भास्कररश्मिकल्पैः॥
en: Having pierced those foremost monkeys with golden-hued maces, he showered on Rāma and Lakşmaņa arrows resembling the rays of the sun.

sa: स राक्षसस्तत्र सहानुजस्तदा तपश्चचारातुलमुग्रविक्रमः। अतोषयच्चापि पितामहं विभुं ददौ स तुष्टश्च वराञ्जयावहान॥
en: There the Rākşasa of unrivalled prowess along with his younger brother carried on austerities and thus gratified that lord-the greatfather. And being gratified (with him), he conferred on him boons bringing on victory.

sa: ततः सहस्ताभरणान्प्रगृह्य विपुलान्भुजान्। अब्रुवंत्रिदशश्रेष्ठा राघवं प्राञ्जलिं स्थितम्॥
en: Thereupon raising up their huge hands, decked with various ornaments and folding them, those foremost of the celestials said to Raghava.

sa: विस्फुरन्नयनं चास्य सव्यं युद्धाभिनन्दिनः॥ विवर्णो मुखवर्णश्च गद्गदश्चाभवत्स्वनः।
en: The left eye of that one delighting in encounter, began to throb. And his continence grew pale, and his voice faltered.

sa: अचिरेणैव कालेन प्राप्स्याम्येनं मनोरथम्। दुष्प्रस्थानोऽयमाभाति सर्वेषां वो विपर्ययः॥
en: And soon shall this desire of mine be fulfilled. All these words of mine do sound improbable now but they all indicate your misfortune.

sa: स तं परित्यज्य महारथो रथं सकार्मुकः खङ्गधरः खमुत्पतन्। ततोऽभियोगादृषिरुग्रवीर्यवान् विहाय देहं मरुतामिवालयम्॥
en: Thereat, forsaking that car, the mighty car warrior sprang up into sky with his bow and holding his sabre, and (resembled) an ascetic of fierce energy consequent on austerities, going up to heaven, renouncing his body.

sa: ततस्तलेनाभिहतो महारथः स तस्य पिङ्गाधिपमन्त्रिनिर्जितः। स भग्ननीडः परिवृत्तकूबरः पपात भूमौ हतवाजिरम्बरात्॥
en: And successfully assailed by the councillor of that lord of monkey, the car with its seat smashed, and its pole broken, and deprived of its steeds, fell to the earth from the sky.

sa: तथैव रणरक्तस्तु मुष्टिना वासवानुजम्। ताडयित्वा धनुर्मात्रमपक्रान्तो निशाचरः॥
en: And that night-ranger delighting in battle, dealing a box at Vāsavā's younger brother, moved away a distance measuring a bow's length.

sa: ततोऽन्यं वृक्षमुत्पाट्य कृत्वा वेगमनुत्तमम्। शिरस्याभिजघानाशु राक्षसेन्द्रमकम्पनम्॥
en: Then uprooting another tree, (Hanuman) summoning up hi best impetuosity, swiftly hit Akampana foremost of Rākşasas-on the head.

sa: जाम्बवन्तं तु दशभिर्नीलं त्रिंशद्भिरेव च। सुग्रीवमृषभं चैव सोऽङ्गदं द्विविदं तथा॥
en: He pierced Jāmbavān with ten and Nīla with thirty. And then with dreadful sharp shafts obtained as boons, he rendered Sugrīva and Riş abha and Angada and Dvivida (almost) lifeless.

sa: स तु वर्षसहस्राणि तपस्तप्त्वा महावने। यन्त्रितो नियमैरुप्रैश्चकार सुमहत्तपः॥
en: For a thousand years, he, having his senses controlled, practised rigid austerities in that mighty forest, observing (all the while) the most rigorous restrictions.

sa: स पुच्छमुद्यम्य भुजंगकल्पं विनम्य पृष्ठं श्रवणे निकुच्य। मापुप्लुवे व्योम्नि च चण्डवेगः॥
en: Then upraising his tail resembling a serpent, bending his back, contracting his ears, and opening his mouth looking like that of a mare, that one possessed of terrific impetuosity, bounded into the sky.

sa: तमात्तबाणासनमाहवोन्मुखं खमास्तृणन्तं विविधैः शरोत्तमैः। अवैक्षताक्षं बहुमानचक्षुषा जगाम चिन्तां स मारुतात्मजः॥
en: And witness Akșa with regardful eyes, as that one intent on contest, taking his bow, was covering the sky with various excellent arrows, the Wind-god's offspring was plunged in thought.

sa: नेमौ मोक्षयितुं शक्यावेतस्मादिषुबन्धनात्। सर्वैरपि समागम्य सर्षिसङ्घः सुरासुरैः॥
en: All the celestials and Asuras assembled together with the saints, are incompetent to emancipate these from the fetters of my shafts.

sa: राक्षसाधिपतिं चापि ददर्श कपिसत्तमः। तेजोबलसमायुक्तं तपन्तमिव भास्करम्॥
en: And that best of monkeys too saw that lord of Rākşasas, endowed with strength and energy and resembling the resplendent sun.

sa: त्वां कृत्वोपरतो मन्ये रूपकर्ता स विश्वकृत्। नहि रूपोपमा ह्यन्या तवास्ति शुभदर्शने॥
en: O you of a fair look, having created you, the artist of Gods, the maker of celestial beauties, has ceased from his work, for a match of your beauty I find in none.

sa: ततः शिखरमारुह्य रामो दशरथात्मजः। कूर्ममीनसमाकीर्णमपश्यत्सलिलाकुलम्॥
en: Getting at the top, Daśaratha's son espied the vast deep filled with tortoises and fishes.

sa: तां चित्रमाल्याभरणां कपिराजहितंकरः॥ राघवार्थे चरञ्श्रीमान् ददर्श च ननन्द च।
en: And that graceful one serving in the interests of the king of monkeys, ranging for Rāma's behoof, beheld (Lankā) adorned with variegated wreaths; and was highly delighted.

sa: राक्षसोऽसीति हरयो वानरोऽसीति राक्षसाः। अन्योन्यं समरे जघ्नुस्तस्मिंस्तमसि दारुणे॥
en: In that profound darkness, the monkeys and the Rākşasas began to slay each other, exclaiming, You are a Raksasa,' and 'you are a monkey.'

sa: भगवन्पूर्वमप्येषा लङ्कासीत्पिशिताशिनाम्। श्रुत्वेदं भगवद्वाक्यं जातो मे विस्मयः परः॥
en: O worshipful one, hearing your words that formerly Lankā had been in the possession of the flesh-eaters, I have been seized with great amazement.

sa: आदित्यपथमाश्रित्य जगाम स गतश्रमः। हनूमांस्त्वरितो वीरः पितुस्तुल्यपराक्रमः॥
en: That hero Hanuman—like to his father in prowess, and incapable of being fatigued, vigorously proceeded along the orbit of the sun.

sa: सा वानराणां ध्वजिनी सुग्रीवेणाभिपालिता। त्रिधा निविष्टा महती रामस्यार्थपराभवत्॥
en: That huge army of the monkeys commanded by Sugrīva, and set up in three divisions, were deeply concerned with the accomplishment of Rāma's work.

sa: स संप्रहारस्तुमुलो मांसशोणितकर्दमः। रक्षसां वानराणां च संबभूवाद्भुतोपमः।॥
en: That encounter of the Rākşasas and the monkeys was mighty and wonderful, and the ground became wet with flesh and gore.

sa: अकामा तेन यस्मात्त्वं बलाद्भद्रे प्रधर्षिता॥ तस्मात्स युवतीमन्यां नाकामामुपयास्यति।
en: O fair one, since you have been ravished by him despite your unwillingness he shall never be able to get by an unwilling damsel.

sa: ततो रक्षो महानादान्मुक्त्वा हन्ति स्म वारुणान्। नानाप्रहरणोपेतैर्धारापातैरिवाम्बुदः।॥
en: Thereupon emitting loud cries the Rākşasa, like to a cloud, with a downpour of diverse shafts, destroyed the offspring of Varuna.

sa: तस्मिंस्तु काले हनुमानरुजत्स दुरासदम्। धरणीधरसंकाशो महावृक्षमरिंदमः॥
en: At this time that subduer of enemies, Hanumăn-resembling a mountain, uprooted a giant tree incapable of being handled.

sa: प्रासैः प्रमाथिताः केचिद्वानराः शोणितस्त्रवाः। मुद्गरैराहताः केचित्पतिता धरणीतले॥
en: Some of the monkeys, sore assailed with prāśas, began to bleed; and some, wounded with maces, dropped down to the ground.

sa: ऐश्वर्यं वानराणां च दुर्लभं वालिपालितम्। अस्या निमित्ते सुग्रीवः प्राप्तवाँलोकविश्रुतः॥
en: And it was on her account that Sugrīva, known all over the world, came by the wealth of the monkeys hard to acquire and amassed by Vali.

sa: ततः शरीरं संक्षिप्य तन्महीधरसंनिभम्। पुनः प्रकृतिमापेदे वीतमोह इवात्मवान्॥
en: Thus thought that magnanimous one. Thereat diminishing that person of his resembling a mountain, that self-possessed one, purged on ignorance, resumed his natural shape.

sa: देवदेवं ब्रुवाणं तं रक्ताम्बुरुहलोचनम्। शक्त्या बिभेद संक्रुद्धो राक्षसेन्द्रो भुजान्तरे॥
en: As that god of gods having eyes resembling the red lotuses was speaking thus, the lord of Rākşasas in high wrath pierced his breast with a dart.

sa: वाहि वात यतः कान्ता तां स्पृष्ट्वा मामपि स्पृश। त्वयि मे गात्रसंस्पर्शश्चन्द्रे दृष्टिसमागमः॥
en: O Wind, do you go there where my dear spouse is, and touching her person, do you touch me, for I shall then be happy stationing my looks in the Moon and being touched by you.

sa: सायकैश्चापविभ्रष्टैर्वज्रकल्पैः सुदारुणैः। दारयन्ति स्म संक्रुद्धा मेघा इव महागिरिम्॥
en: As the clouds, with a thousand torrents cleave a mountain, so they, with dreadful shafts, resembling thunderbolts and discharged off the bows, pierced him.

sa: अपयाते त्वयि तदा समुद्रान्तमृगद्विजम्। परिघूनमिवात्यर्थं तद्वनं समपद्यत॥ तद्धस्तिमृदितं घोरं सिंहव्याघ्रमृगाकुलम्। प्रविवेशाथ विजनं स महद्दण्डकावनम्॥
en: Yourself having returned thence, all the bird and animals were overwhelmed with terror and that forest appeared as if distressed. Thereupon he entered the solitary and huge and dreadful forest Daņdaka distressed by the elephants and abounding in lion, tigers and deer.

sa: स ताभ्यां सहसोत्प्लुत्य विष्ठितो विमलेऽम्बरे। मुद्गराभ्यां महाबाहुर्वक्षस्यभिहतः कपिः॥
en: And springing up suddenly, they by means of maces, dealt blows on the chest of the monkey, who was staying in the unclouded sky.

sa: मित्रमौपयिकं कर्तुं रामः स्थानं परिप्सता। बन्धं चानिच्छता घोरं त्वयासौ पुरुषर्षभः॥
en: It behove you to make friends with Rāma, that best of men, if do you desire to maintain your empire and do not wish to bring about your own destruction.

sa: एवं विलपतस्तस्य तत्र रामस्य धीमतः। दिनक्षयान्मन्दवपुर्भास्करोऽस्तमुपागतः॥
en: The highly intelligent Rāma bewailing thus, the day passed away and the Sun, decreasing gradually, disappeared at last.

sa: स योजनसहस्राणि समतीत्य महाकपिः। दिव्यौषधिधरं शैलं व्यचरन्मारुतात्मजः॥
en: That mighty monkey-the Wind-god's son-leaving behind a thousand Yojanas, began to range the mountain containing the divine remedies in its entrails.

sa: एष दत्तवरः शेते प्रमाथी राक्षसेश्वरः। तव हेतोविशालाक्षि निहतो रावणो मया॥
en: Do you behold, O you having expansive eyes, Rāvaņa, the lord of Rākşasas, the repressor of people and who obtained a boon, lying there, slain by me on your account.

sa: ततो मया वाग्भिरदीनभाषिणी शिवाभिरिष्टाभिरभिप्रसादिता। उवाह शान्तिं मम मैथिलात्मजा तवातिशोकेन तथातिपीडिता॥
en: That daughter of the king of Mithilā although heavily laden with sorrow in your absence was greatly comforted and pleased by my auspicious words boding the fulfilment of her desire.

sa: शूराश्च बलवन्तश्च वरुणश्च सुता रणे। निर्जितास्ते महाभाग चतुर्विधबलानुगाः॥
en: O great hero, by you were defeated in battle, the heroic and powerful sons of Varuņa, followed by a fourfold division of their army.

sa: अनेन च महाराज माहेश्वरमनुत्तमम्। इष्ट्वा यज्ञं वरो लब्धो लोके परमदुर्लभः॥
en: This one, O mighty monarch, having celebrated the the Māheśvara* sacrifice, has obtained a noble boon, rarely (attained by persons). *Relating to Mahasvara, the great Lord, a designation of Sivā.

sa: ततो ह्यभ्युच्छ्रयन्पौराः पताकाश्च गृहे गृहे। ऐक्ष्वाकाध्युषितं रम्यमाससाद पितुर्मुहम्।॥
en: Thereupon the citizens hoisted up flags upon every house and he reached the picturesque abode of his ancestors inhabited by the descendants of Ikşvāku.

sa: रामः स्वबाहुवीर्येण स्वराज्यं प्रत्यपादयत्। वालिनं समरे हत्वा महाकायं महाबलम्॥
en: Thereupon slaying the huge-bodied and highly powerful Vāli in the conflict by virtue of the strength of his own arms Rāma obtained (for Sugriva) his own kingdom.

sa: स रथेनाग्निवर्णेन बलवानरावणात्मजः। इन्द्रजित्कवची खङ्गी सध्वजः प्रत्यदृश्यत ।।।।
en: Ravana's son Indrajit, endowed with strength, mailed, and armed with a sword, and furnished with a banner, was seen mounted on a fire-hued chariot.

sa: दीप्तपावकसंकाशैः शरैः काञ्चनभूषणैः। अभ्यवर्षद्रणे रामो दशग्रीवं समाहितः॥
en: In the encounter Rāma, concentrating his thoughts, showered on the Ten-necked one arrows embellished with gold and looking like living fire.

sa: क्षितिक्षमा पुष्करसंनिभेक्षणा या रक्षिता राघवलक्ष्मणाभ्याम्। सा राक्षसीभिर्विकृतेक्षणाभिः संरक्ष्यते सम्प्रति वृक्षमूले॥
en: She, patient as the Earth, having eyes resembling lotuses, who was ere this protected by Rāghava and Lakşmaņa, is now being guarded by Rākşasīs having terrible eyes, under the trees.

sa: ततो हरिर्गन्धवहात्मजस्तु तमोषधीशैलमुदग्रवेगः। निनाय वेगाद्धिमवन्तमेव पुनश्च रामेण समाजगाम।७३ ।।
en: Then that monkey, the offspring of the bearer of fragrance, endowed with terrific speed, took that medicinal mountain (back) to Himavān and again presented himself before Rāma.

sa: हृतहृत्सा हनुमता पपात विधुराम्भसि। स्वयम्भुवैव हनुमान् सृष्टास्तस्या निपातने॥
en: Her heart having been crushed out by Hanuman, she, rendered lifeless, fell into the water. The self-create had created him for compassing her destruction.

sa: रामलक्ष्मणयोर्दृष्ट्वा शरीरे सायकैश्चिते। सर्वाणि चाङ्गोपाङ्गानि सुग्रीवं भयमाविशत्॥
en: Seeing the bodies as well as the limbs of Rāma and Lakşmana, covered entirely with arrows, fear took possession of Sugriva.

sa: सर्वकामसमृद्धं हि हस्त्यश्वरसंकुलम्। पितृपैतामहं राज्यं कस्य नावर्तयेन्मनः॥
en: Whose mind does not change obtaining such an ancestral kingdom, filled with all prosperity and abounding in elephants, horses and chariots?

sa: अतिवेगोऽतिवेगेन भ्रामयित्वा महोत्कटः। परिघं पातयामास जम्बुमालेमहोरसि ॥
en: That terrific one gifted with exceeding impetuosity, having whirled the bolt with wondrous rapidity, let it light upon Jambumāli's spacious breast.

sa: हतं त्रिशिरसं दृष्ट्वा युद्धोन्मत्तं तथैव च। हतौ प्रेक्ष्य दुराधर्षों देवान्तकनरान्तकौ॥ चुकोप परमामर्षी मत्तो राक्षसपुङ्गवः। जग्राहार्चिष्मतीं चापि गदां सर्वायसीं तदा॥ हेमपट्टपरिक्षिप्तां मांसशोणितफेनिलाम्। विराजमानां विपुलां शत्रुशोणिततर्पिताम्॥ तेजसा संप्रदीप्ताग्रां रक्तमाल्यविभूषिताम्। ऐरावतमहापद्मसार्वभौमभयावहाम्॥ गदामादाय संक्रुद्धो मत्तो राक्षसपुङ्गवः। हरीन्समभिदुद्राव युगान्ताग्निरिव ज्वलन्॥
en: Seeing Triſira and Yuddhonmatta slain and seeing also the irrepressible Devāntaka and Narāntaka slain (in the encounter), that highly irascible and powerful Räkşasas-Matta, was transported with passion, and then took up a flaming mace entirely wrought with iron inlaid with gold; frothy with flesh and gore; mighty to behold; gratified with the blood of foes; with its end flaming in splendour; decked with red wreaths; and capable of striking terror into Airāvata and Mahāpadma and Sárvabhauma.* And flaming up like the fire arisen at the end of a Yuga, that foremost of Raksasas-Matta, wrought with fury, rushed against the monkeys. *Elephants of the cardinal points.

sa: क्रव्यादानां मृगाणां च पुरीद्वारेषु सङ्घशः। श्रूयन्ते विपुला घोषाः सविस्फूर्जतनिःस्वनाः॥
en: Wolves and other (ferocious) animals, as well as deer, approaching the gate of the palace in swarms, are heard to set up loud roars resembling the thunder.

sa: तेन मुष्टिप्रहारेण संचुकोप महाकपिः। कुपितश्च निजग्राह किरीटे राक्षसर्षभम्॥
en: At that blow, the redoubtable monkey was wrought up with wrath; and inflamed with rage, he smote that foremost of Räkşasas about his diadem.

sa: इत्येवमुक्त्वा सुरसैन्यनाशनो महाबलः संयति चण्डविक्रमः। दशाननो भ्रातरमाप्तवादिनं विसर्जयामास तदा विभीषणम्॥
en: Having said this, that destroyer of celestial hosts, the Ten-necked one, possessed of mighty strength and of terrific prowess in battle, then dismissed his brother Vibhīşaņa, who had spoken truth.

sa: तं समीक्ष्य महासत्त्वं सत्त्ववान् हरिसत्तमः। वाक्यमर्थवदव्यग्रस्तमुवाच दशाननम्॥
en: Seeing the Ten-necked one of mighty energy, that foremost of monkeys, endued with strength, calmly spoke to him words containing sense,

sa: हार्दह्यमानैश्च ज्वालाप्रज्वलितैरपि॥ रात्रौ सा दृश्यते लङ्का पुष्पितैरिव किंशुकैः।
en: In consequence of those tops of the edifices burning and of the living flames, that night Lankā looked as if swarming with flowering Kinsukas.

sa: अन्ये तु परमक्रुद्धा राक्षसा भीमविक्रमाः। तलैरेवाभिधावन्ति वज्रस्पर्शसमैर्हरीन्॥
en: Other Rākşasas endowed with dreadful vigour, waxing wondrous wroth, dealt the monkeys slaps with hands having the touch of the thunder-bolt.

sa: मां तु दृष्ट्वा प्रधावन्तमनीकं संप्रहर्षितम्। त्यजन्तु हरयस्त्रासं भुक्तपूर्वामिव स्रजम्॥
en: But seeing me, let the forces rushing about, cheered up, as well as the monkeys, cast off all fear, like a wreath that has been used before.

sa: ततो युद्धं समभवद्देवदानवरक्षसाम्। घोरं तुमुलनिर्हादं नानाप्रहरणोद्यतम्॥
en: Thereupon there ensued a conflict, setting up a terrible sound, with various weapons between the Räksasas and gods.

sa: गजदन्तमयीं दिव्यां शिबिकान्तरिक्षगाम्॥ युक्तां वाजिसहस्रेण स्वयमास्थाय राघवः। शुक्लमाल्याम्बरधरो लक्ष्मणेन समागतः॥
en: I saw Rāma, wearing garlands and clothed in white, ride in a celestial chariot, along with Lakşmaņa, made of ivory, traversing the etherial regions and drawn by a hundred steeds.

sa: नारीजनस्य धूमेन व्याप्तस्योच्चैर्विनेदुषः। स्वनो ज्वलनतप्तस्य शुश्रुवे शतयोजनम्॥
en: The cries of the females amidst the drift of smoke, heated by the flames, could be heard from an hundred Yojanas.

sa: राघवश्च पुनदृष्टश्चतुर्दन्तं महागजम्॥ आरूढः शैलसंकाशं चकास सहलक्ष्मणः।
en: I again saw Rāma and Lakşmaņa appear in effulgence, seated on a huge elephant, having four tusks and resembling a bull.

sa: अटन्ति वसुधां कृत्स्नां वयमन्ये च वानराः॥ दशनागबलाः केचित्केचिद् दशगुणोत्तराः। केचिनागसहस्रस्य बभूवुस्तुल्यविक्रमाः॥
en: Some are endowed with the strength of ten elephants, some with the strength of an hundred, some have the prowess of a thousand elephants, and some the strength of elephants numbered by herds.

sa: किं त्वमन्तःपुरे सीते सर्वभूतमनोरमे। महार्हशयनोपेते न वासमनुमन्यसे॥
en: Why do you not desire, O Sītā, to live in his inner apartment, liked by all and abounding in costly bed-steads.

sa: न शेकुः समवस्थातुं निहते वाहिनीपतौ। सेतुबन्धं समासाद्य विशीणं सलिलं यथा॥ हते तस्मिंश्चमूमुख्ये राक्षसास्ते निरुद्यमाः। रक्षःपतिगृहं गत्वा ध्यानमूकत्वमागताः।। प्राप्ताः शोकार्णवं तीव्र विसंज्ञा इव तेऽभवन्।५८।।
en: And like waters rushing (through a breach in) a dyke, the Rākşasas could not stand their ground, on their leader being slain. And on that head of the hosts being killed, the Rākşasas, growing dispirited, repairing to the residence of the lord of Rākşasa, remained plunged in thought, without speaking anything. And plunged in that sea of sorrow, they seemed as if they had been bereft of their senses.

sa: शापोत्सर्गाद्धितस्येदं मुनेः सर्वमुपस्थितम्। तत्स्मर त्वं महाबाहो दुष्कृतं यत्त्वया कृतम्॥
en: You have met with all this in consequence of the imprecation of that ascetic. Therefore, O you having long arms, do you think of your past iniquity.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा महाकायश्चैत्यस्थो हरियूथपः। ननाद भीमनिर्हादो रक्षसां जनयन्भयम्॥
en: Having spoken thus, that one of a prodigious person, seated on the Caitya, emitted tremendous roars, striking terror into the Raksasa.

sa: विषण्णवदना भूयो विप्रकीर्णशिरोरुहाः। मूढाः शोणितगन्धेन निपेतुर्धरणीतले॥
en: With woebegone faces, and with hair dishevelled, (the Raksasas), stupified with the smell of blood, saught the earth.

sa: तस्मिन्हते राक्षसयोधमुख्ये महाबले संयति देवशत्रौ। क्रुद्धस्त्रिशीर्षो निशितास्त्रमुग्रं ववर्ष नीलोरसि बाणवर्षम्॥
en: On that fierce and mighty Rākşasas warriorthat foe of the immortals— having fallen in fight, the three-headed one, waxing wondrous enraged began to shower terrific sharpened shafts on Nila's chest.

sa: तन्त्रीस्वराः कर्णसुखाः प्रवृत्ताः स्वपन्ति नार्यः पतिभिः सुवृत्ताः। नक्तंचराश्चापि तथा प्रवृत्ता विहर्तुमत्यद्भुतरौद्रवृत्ताः॥
en: The sounds of strings sweet to the ear spread around; females sleep besides their husbands; and night-rangers, given to astounding and terrible acts, are, in the same way, out, indulging in their sports.

sa: अन्या कमलपत्राक्षी पूर्णेन्दुसदृशानना। अन्यामालिङ्गय सुश्रोणी प्रसुप्ता मदविह्वला॥
en: And another lotus-eyed and moon-faced fair one, coming under the governance of slumber, (was asleep), embracing another furnished with shapely hips.

sa: अवन्दत महाबाहुस्ततस्तां जनकात्मजाम्। सा चैनं भयसंत्रस्ता भूयो नैनमुदैक्षत॥
en: In the meantime the mighty-armed monkey bowed to Janaka's daughter, but she, worked up with fear, did not cast again her looks towards him.

sa: गरुडाधिष्ठितावेतावुभौ राघवलक्ष्मणौ। त्यक्त्वा मोहं वधिष्येते सगणं रावणं रणे॥
en: Both these-Rāma and Lakşmaņa-are under the aegis of Garuda; and, casting off their stupor: they will in battle slay Rävaņa along with his adherents.

sa: बलेन येन वै सीतां मायया राक्षसाधम। मामतिक्रमयित्वा त्वं हृतवांस्तनिदर्शय॥
en: O worst of Rākşasas, do you display that prowess of your by which, aided by your power of illusion, you have forcible carried off Sītā, disregarding me.

sa: प्रतिगृह्य मणिं दोभ्यां तव हेतो रघुप्रिय॥ शिरसा सम्प्रणम्यैनामहमागमने त्वरे।
en: O you, the most favourite of the Raghu race, taking for you that gem with my hands and bowing to her, I addressed myself speedily for departure.

sa: त्रयः सुकेशस्य सुतास्त्रेताग्निसमतेजसः। विवृद्धिमगमंस्तत्र व्याधयोपेक्षिता इव ॥
en: The three sons of Sukeśa, having the energy of the three fires, grew up like a disease which has been disregarded.

sa: मत्तप्रमत्तानि समाकुलानि रथाश्वभद्रासनसंकुलानि। वीरश्रिया चापि समाकुलानि ददर्श धीमान् स कपिः कुलानि॥
en: The intelligent monkey saw mansions crowded with (Raksasas), some inebriate with wine and other with wealth, and abounding in cars and horses and golden seats; and fraught with the grace got of heroism.

sa: अपदेशो मे जनकानोत्पत्तिर्वसुधातलात्। मम वृत्तं च वृत्तज्ञ बहु तेन पुरस्कृतम्॥
en: Although I am known to have a father but in fact I am born of the earth. You did not sufficiently honour my character, O you conversant with character. are

sa: परिघाभिहतश्चापि वानरेन्द्रात्मजस्तदा॥ जानुभ्यां पतितो भूमौ पुनरेवोत्पपात ह।
en: And albeit struck with the bludgeon, the son of the lord of monkeys, going down on his knees, again darted up.

sa: तन्न खल्वेष ते सौम्य पात्यो रावणमूर्धनि। नह्यस्मिन्पतिते कश्चिन्मुहूर्तमपि जीवति॥
en: Therefore, O mild one, you forsooth should not bring it down on Rāvana's head. If this alights on any one, he does not live for a moment.

sa: सोऽहं रिपुविनाशाय विजयायाविचारयन्। स्वयमेव गमिष्यामि रणशीर्षं तदद्भुतम्॥
en: Therefore, without taking thought, will I, for compassing the destruction of the foe myself march to that marvellous field of fight.

sa: अद्य तद्वानरानीकं रामं च सलक्ष्मणम्। निर्दहिष्यामि बाणौधैर्वनं दीप्तैरिवाग्निभिः॥
en: Today, even as a flaming fire burn down a forest, will I with showers of shafts burn up that monkey-army, and Rama and Laksmana.

sa: राक्षसेन्द्रोऽभिषिक्तस्तु भ्रातृभिः सहितस्तदा। ततः प्रदानं राक्षस्या भगिन्याः समचिन्तयत्॥
en: The lord of Räkşasas was installed along with his brothers. And then he thought of the giving away in marriage of his Rakşasi sister.

sa: तमागतमभिप्रेक्ष्य नागास्ते विप्रदुद्रुवुः। यैस्तु तौ पुरुषौ बद्धौ शरभूतैर्महाबलैः॥
en: Seeing him come, the serpents began to dart away, those exceedingly powerful ones that, turning into shafts, had bound those persons.* *Rama and Laksmana.

sa: स त्रिभिनैर्ऋतश्रेष्ठैर्युगपत्समभिद्रुतः। न विव्यथे महातेजा वालिपुत्रः प्रतापवान्॥
en: Attacked simultaneously by those three powerful Naiſtas, the exceedingly energetic son of Vali's possessed of prowess, did not feel any pain.

sa: अतिबलसदृशैः पराक्रमैस्त्वं मम कुलवंशविवर्धनः प्रभो। यदयमतुलबलस्त्वयाद्य वै त्रिदशपतिस्त्रिदशाश्च निर्जिताः॥
en: You have enhanced the glory of our race displaying the prowess like a highly powerful man. You have vanquished the celestials and their king of unequalled might.

sa: रावणं क्रुद्धमाज्ञाय महापार्यो महाबलः। मुहूर्तमनुसंचिन्त्य प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: Seeing Ravana wrought up with wrath, the exceedingly strong Mahāpārsva, reflecting for a moment, observed with joined hands.

sa: अवेक्षमाणो वैदेही कोपसंरक्तलोचनः। उवाच रावणः सीतां भुजङ्ग इव निःश्वसन्॥
en: And having his eyes red hot with ire, sighing again and again like to a snake and casting his looks upon Sītā, Rāvaņa addressed her again, saying.

sa: भ्रातृव्यसनसंतप्तस्तदा देवान्तको बली। आदाय परिघं घोरमङ्गदं समभिद्रवत्॥
en: Aggrieved in consequence of the calamity that had befallen his brother, the strong Devāntaka grasping a dreadful bludgeon, darted against Angada.

sa: बलात्कुक्कुटवृत्तेन प्रवर्तस्व महाबल। आक्रम्याक्रम्य सीतां वै तां भुङ्क्व च रमस्व च।४॥
en: O you endowed with prodigious power, do you exerting your might lead your life, after the manner of hens, and invading Sītā again and again, do you enjoy her and derive pleasure (therefrom).

sa: कुम्भकर्णः सहास्माभिरिन्द्रजिच्च महाबलः। प्रतिषेधयितुं शक्तौ सवज्रमपि वज्रिणम्॥
en: Kumbhakarņa along with us, as well the exceedingly powerful Indrajit, are competent to chastise the thunder-bearing (Deity) equipped with his thunder.

sa: वैवस्वत महाबाहो न खल्वमितविक्रम। न हन्तव्यस्त्वयैतेन दण्डेनैष निशाचरः॥
en: O Vaivasvata, O mighty-armed one, O you of immeasurable prowess, this certainly must not be. You should not with your rod slay the nightranger.

sa: समाजश्च महान् वृत्तो गीतवादित्रनि:स्वनः। पिबतां रक्तमाल्यानां रक्षसां रक्तवाससाम्॥ लङ्का चेयं पुरी रम्या सवाजिरथकुञ्जरा। सागरे पतिता दृष्टा भग्नगोपुरतोरणा॥
en: And there was audible in the large assembly sound of music and stringed instruments. And all the Rākşasa wearing crimson clothes and garlands, were quaffing oil, I saw the royal and picturesque city Lankā with her steeds, cars and elephants, drowned in the ocean, having her gateways and ornamented arches broken.
